```text
760	@@ -0,0 +1,170 @@
761	+import { ProductTypes } from "@medusajs/framework/types"
762	+import { Modules } from "@medusajs/framework/utils"
763	+import {
764	+  WorkflowData,
765	+  WorkflowResponse,
766	+  createHook,
767	+  createWorkflow,
768	+  transform,
769	+} from "@medusajs/framework/workflows-sdk"
770	+import { batchLinksWorkflow } from "../../common/workflows/batch-links"
771	+import { loadBundleStep } from "../steps/load-bundle"
772	+import { prepareBundleStep } from "../steps/prepare-bundle"
773	+import {
774	+  BUNDLE_METADATA_KEY,
775	+  BundleComponentInput,
776	+  BundleInventoryLink,
777	+} from "../utils/bundle"
778	+import { updateProductsWorkflow } from "./update-products"
779	+
780	+/**
781	+ * The data to update a bundle. Every field is optional.
782	+ */
783	+export type UpdateBundleWorkflowInput = {
784	+  /**
785	+   * The ID of the bundle product.
786	+   */
787	+  id: string
788	+  update: Omit<ProductTypes.UpdateProductDTO, "variants" | "options"> & {
789	+    /**
790	+     * Replaces the full list of components (and quantities).
791	+     */
792	+    components?: BundleComponentInput[]
793	+    /**
794	+     * Replaces the bundle's prices.
795	+     */
796	+    prices?: {
797	+      currency_code: string
798	+      amount: number
799	+      min_quantity?: number | null
800	+      max_quantity?: number | null
801	+      rules?: Record<string, string>
802	+    }[]
803	+  }
804	+}
805	+
806	+export const updateBundleWorkflowId = "update-bundle"
807	+/**
808	+ * This workflow updates a bundle's product fields, components, quantities and
809	+ * prices.
810	+ *
811	+ * When components change, the bundle variant's inventory links are re-built:
812	+ * links that are no longer needed are removed, new ones are added and links
813	+ * whose required quantity changed are updated. Because the bundle has its own
814	+ * prices, a component's price changing never changes the bundle's price.
815	+ *
816	+ * @example
817	+ * const { result } = await updateBundleWorkflow(container).run({
818	+ *   input: {
819	+ *     id: "prod_bundle",
820	+ *     update: {
821	+ *       title: "Camera kit v2",
822	+ *       prices: [{ currency_code: "usd", amount: 849 }],
823	+ *     },
824	+ *   },
825	+ * })
826	+ *
827	+ * @summary
828	+ *
829	+ * Update a product bundle.
830	+ *
831	+ * @property hooks.bundleUpdated - Executed after the bundle is updated.
832	+ */
833	+export const updateBundleWorkflow = createWorkflow(
834	+  updateBundleWorkflowId,
835	+  (input: WorkflowData<UpdateBundleWorkflowInput>) => {
836	+    // The current bundle (throws NOT_FOUND if it doesn't exist or isn't one).
837	+    const current = loadBundleStep({ id: input.id })
838	+
839	+    // Validates new components (if any) before anything is changed.
840	+    const componentsToValidate = transform(
841	+      { input },
842	+      (data) => data.input.update.components
843	+    )
844	+    const prepared = prepareBundleStep({ components: componentsToValidate })
845	+
846	+    // Product fields + the bundle's marker metadata + prices on its variant.
847	+    const productUpdate = transform({ input, current }, (data) => {
848	+      const { components, prices, metadata, ...productFields } =
849	+        data.input.update
850	+
851	+      return {
852	+        selector: { id: data.input.id },
853	+        update: {
854	+          ...productFields,
855	+          // Always write the marker back: new components if sent, otherwise
856	+          // the existing ones. Caller metadata can never remove the marker.
857	+          metadata: {
858	+            ...(metadata ?? {}),
859	+            [BUNDLE_METADATA_KEY]: {
860	+              components: components ?? data.current.components,
861	+            },
862	+          },
863	+          ...(prices
864	+            ? { variants: [{ id: data.current.variant_id, prices }] }
865	+            : {}),
866	+        },
867	+      }
868	+    })
869	+
870	+    const updatedProducts = updateProductsWorkflow.runAsStep({
871	+      input: productUpdate as any,
872	+    })
873	+
874	+    // Compare the links the bundle variant has now with the links it needs.
875	+    const linkChanges = transform({ current, prepared }, (data) => {
876	+      if (!data.prepared.links) {
877	+        return { create: [], update: [], delete: [] }
878	+      }
879	+
880	+      const variantRef = { variant_id: data.current.variant_id }
881	+      const existing = new Map<string, BundleInventoryLink>(
882	+        data.current.links.map((link) => [link.inventory_item_id, link])
883	+      )
884	+      const wanted = new Map<string, BundleInventoryLink>(
885	+        data.prepared.links.map((link) => [link.inventory_item_id, link])
886	+      )
887	+
888	+      return {
889	+        // needed but not linked yet
890	+        create: [...wanted.values()]
891	+          .filter((link) => !existing.has(link.inventory_item_id))
892	+          .map((link) => ({
893	+            [Modules.PRODUCT]: variantRef,
894	+            [Modules.INVENTORY]: { inventory_item_id: link.inventory_item_id },
895	+            data: { required_quantity: link.required_quantity },
896	+          })),
897	+        // linked and still needed, but with a different quantity
898	+        update: [...wanted.values()]
899	+          .filter(
900	+            (link) =>
901	+              existing.has(link.inventory_item_id) &&
902	+              existing.get(link.inventory_item_id)!.required_quantity !==
903	+                link.required_quantity
904	+          )
905	+          .map((link) => ({
906	+            [Modules.PRODUCT]: variantRef,
907	+            [Modules.INVENTORY]: { inventory_item_id: link.inventory_item_id },
908	+            data: { required_quantity: link.required_quantity },
909	+          })),
910	+        // linked but no longer needed
911	+        delete: [...existing.values()]
912	+          .filter((link) => !wanted.has(link.inventory_item_id))
913	+          .map((link) => ({
914	+            [Modules.PRODUCT]: variantRef,
915	+            [Modules.INVENTORY]: { inventory_item_id: link.inventory_item_id },
916	+          })),
917	+      }
918	+    })
919	+
920	+    batchLinksWorkflow.runAsStep({ input: linkChanges as any })
921	+
922	+    const bundle = transform({ updatedProducts }, (data) => {
923	+      return data.updatedProducts[0]
924	+    })
925	+
926	+    const bundleUpdated = createHook("bundleUpdated", { bundle })
927	+
928	+    return new WorkflowResponse(bundle, { hooks: [bundleUpdated] })
929	+  }
930	+)
```

```text
import { isDefined } from "./is-defined"
import { isObject } from "./is-object"
import { isString } from "./is-string"

export function isPresent(value: any): boolean {
  if (!isDefined(value) || value === null) {
    return false
  }

  if (isString(value) || Array.isArray(value)) {
    return value.length > 0
  }

  if (value instanceof Map || value instanceof Set) {
    return value.size > 0
  }

  if (isObject(value)) {
    return Object.keys(value).length > 0
  }

  return true
}
```

## Review: PR for #112 (bundle API)

I ran the `reviewing-prs` checks against `git diff develop` on this branch and compared the description with your team's PR format. I haven't run the tests.

**Decision:** `needs-changes`. Add the label `requires-more` and remove `initial-approval`.

**Summary:** The approach is solid. Bundles reuse inventory kits, so stock reservation and availability work without new tables. Validation lives in one tested function, and the store API hides `metadata` unless the caller asks for it. The test-evidence table maps one row to each acceptance criterion. Two things need fixing before merge:
- An existing product route can quietly turn a bundle back into a plain product.
- A bundle can end up with more than one variant, and the bundle code doesn't handle that.

The description also has a leftover TODO and is missing some sections.

**Blocking points**

1. **The bundle marker can be wiped.** In `packages/medusa/src/api/admin/products/validators.ts` (`ProductMetadata`), the check blocks a `bundle` key but still accepts `metadata: null` and `metadata: {}`.
   - The base service only merges metadata when `isPresent(metadata)` is true (`medusa-internal-service.ts:433`), and `isPresent` is false for `null` and `{}`. So these values are written straight to the database.
   - Result: `POST /admin/products/:bundleId {"metadata": {}}` erases the component list. The product keeps its inventory links, so stock still comes out of the components, but it no longer counts as a bundle. The delete guard then stops protecting its components.
   - Fix: on the plain product routes, reject `metadata` changes for bundle products, or have the update step keep the `bundle` key. Add a test for both `null` and `{}`.
2. **A bundle can have more than one variant.** `packages/core/core-flows/src/product/steps/load-bundle.ts` assumes the bundle's variant is `variants[0]`.
   - Nothing stops an admin from adding a variant or option to a bundle through the normal product routes. The admin UI in issue 3 will show those buttons on the bundle's product page.
   - Query results have no fixed order, so `variants[0]` can be the new variant. The bundle update would then change prices and inventory links on the wrong variant.
   - Fix: block adding variants and options to a bundle product, or find the bundle variant by its inventory links. Add a test.
3. **The description has a placeholder.** The AC13 row still says "TODO(you): list the existing suites you re-ran". Replace it with the actual suites and their results.

**Not blocking**

- **Delete-guard performance.** `validate-no-bundle-usage.ts` reads every product's metadata, 500 at a time, on every product or variant delete, including deletes from imports. A cheaper lookup is possible: get the inventory items of the variants being deleted, find the variants linked to those items, and check only those variants' products. This would also deal with the tech-debt note. Fine as a follow-up.
- **Index engine path untested.** `store/products/route.ts` (`getProductsWithIndexEngine`) adds `metadata` to the fields of `query.index`, but `metadata` is not in the index engine's default schema. I didn't check whether this errors or just leaves out the `bundle` field. AC3 and AC4 are only tested with the index engine turned off.
- **Request types.** The bundle routes type their request bodies with the Zod-inferred types (`AdminCreateBundleType`) instead of the new `HttpTypes.AdminCreateBundle` and `AdminUpdateBundle`, which the conventions require. There are also several `as any` casts on `validatedBody` and workflow inputs.
- **Bundle's own variant can be deleted.** Deleting the bundle's single variant through the variant route leaves a product that is marked as a bundle but has no variant. After that, `POST /admin/bundles/:id` returns a 404 saying the product "is not a bundle". This is related to point 2.

**Description vs. your team's PR format**

- The **Decisions** section should be titled **Design** and split into **Decision**, **Alternatives considered** (at least 2), **Rationale** and **Consequences**.
  - The alternatives read as "create a new bundle". It probably means a separate bundle table.
  - The consequence sentence mixes a benefit (no migration) with a drawback (if a component's own inventory items change later, the bundle's copied links are not updated). Split these into two points.
- **Section order:** Examples should come before Design and Tech Debt, and Test Evidence comes after Tech Debt.
- **Testing** should include the commands to reproduce the run.
- **Additional Context** should have **CI** and **Limitations** bullets instead of "None". The deferred AC12 return case belongs under Limitations.
- **AI-written tests** should say how the expected values were checked, not only that the diff was reviewed.
- **Typos:** "fro", "requried_quanity", "All test".

I didn't run the unit or integration tests. Both bugs come from reading the code, not from reproducing them. Point 1 assumes the product module's update goes through the base service's merge path, which is the default. I didn't write `review-decision.json` into the repo, because that file is meant for the CI pipeline. Say if you want it written.

```text
+import type { IProductModuleService } from "@medusajs/framework/types"
+import { MedusaError, Modules } from "@medusajs/framework/utils"
+import { StepResponse, createStep } from "@medusajs/framework/workflows-sdk"
+import {
+  assertBundleKeepsSingleVariant,
+  assertNoBundleVariants,
+  isBundleMetadata,
+  isEmptyMetadataUpdate,
+  protectBundleUpdate,
+} from "../utils/bundle"
+import type { UpdateProductsStepInput } from "./update-products"
+
+/*
+ * Steps that protect EXISTING bundles from the plain product and variant
+ * workflows (issue #112 review follow-up). A bundle relies on two things:
+ * `product.metadata.bundle` is never lost, and the product has exactly one
+ * variant. All three steps only read data, so none needs a compensation.
+ */
+
+export const protectBundleProductsStepId = "protect-bundle-products"
+/**
+ * This step runs before a product update is applied. For every product in the
+ * update that is a bundle it:
+ *
+ * - drops a `null` or `{}` metadata value, which the base service would use to
+ *   erase the bundle marker (other metadata keys are still merged), and
+ * - rejects variants without an ID, which would add a second variant.
+ *
+ * It returns the input to use for the update. Products that are not bundles
+ * are passed through unchanged, so existing behavior is not affected.
+ */
+export const protectBundleProductsStep = createStep(
+  protectBundleProductsStepId,
+  async (data: UpdateProductsStepInput, { container }) => {
+    const service = container.resolve<IProductModuleService>(Modules.PRODUCT)
+
+    // The input has two shapes (products list, or selector + update). Typing
+    // every return as the full union keeps the step's output type consistent.
+    const respond = (value: UpdateProductsStepInput) =>
+      new StepResponse(value as UpdateProductsStepInput)
+
+    if ("products" in data) {
+      const ids = data.products.map((p) => p.id).filter(Boolean) as string[]
+      if (!ids.length) {
+        return respond(data)
+      }
+
+      const found = await service.listProducts(
+        { id: ids },
+        { select: ["id", "title", "metadata"], take: null }
+      )
+      const bundles = new Map(
+        found
+          .filter((product) => isBundleMetadata(product.metadata))
+          .map((product) => [product.id, product])
+      )
+
+      if (!bundles.size) {
+        return respond(data)
+      }
+
+      return respond({
+        products: data.products.map((product) =>
+          product.id && bundles.has(product.id)
+            ? protectBundleUpdate(product, bundles.get(product.id)!)
+            : product
+        ),
+      })
+    }
+
+    // Selector form: ONE update is applied to every matching product.
+    const found = await service.listProducts(data.selector, {
+      select: ["id", "title", "metadata"],
+      take: null,
+    })
+    const bundles = found.filter((product) => isBundleMetadata(product.metadata))
+
+    if (!bundles.length) {
+      return respond(data)
+    }
+
+    // Every match is a bundle (the normal case: the admin route selects one
+    // product by id). Make the shared update safe: this rejects variants
+    // without an ID and drops a null/{} metadata value.
+    if (bundles.length === found.length) {
+      return respond({
+        selector: data.selector,
+        update: protectBundleUpdate(data.update, bundles[0]),
+      })
+    }
+
+    // Mixed match. Rejects variants without an ID, and the marker key.
+    protectBundleUpdate(data.update, bundles[0])
+
+    // The same update also goes to the non-bundle products that match, so we
+    // can't silently drop it for the bundles only. Reject it instead.
+    if (
+      data.update.metadata !== undefined &&
+      isEmptyMetadataUpdate(data.update.metadata)
+    ) {
+      throw new MedusaError(
+        MedusaError.Types.NOT_ALLOWED,
+        `Metadata can't be cleared on products that include the bundle "${bundles[0].title}" (${bundles[0].id}).`
+      )
+    }
+
+    return respond(data)
+  }
+)
+
+/**
+ * The variants about to be created.
+ */
+export type ValidateBundleVariantsStepInput = {
+  /**
+   * How many variants the request adds, per product ID.
+   */
+  new_variants_by_product: Record<string, number>
+}
+
+export const validateBundleVariantsStepId = "validate-bundle-variants"
+/**
+ * This step blocks creating a variant for a bundle that already has one. It
+ * lets the bundle's own first variant through, so creating a bundle works.
+ */
+export const validateBundleVariantsStep = createStep(
+  validateBundleVariantsStepId,
+  async (input: ValidateBundleVariantsStepInput, { container }) => {
+    const productIds = Object.keys(input.new_variants_by_product)
+    if (!productIds.length) {
+      return new StepResponse(void 0)
+    }
+
+    const service = container.resolve<IProductModuleService>(Modules.PRODUCT)

+/*
+ * Protection of existing bundles from the PLAIN product routes.
+ *
+ * The bundle workflows assume a bundle product has exactly one variant (the one
+ * linked to the component inventory items) and that `metadata.bundle` is never
+ * lost. The plain product and variant routes know nothing about bundles, so the
+ * functions below let the shared workflows protect them.
+ */
+
+/**
+ * True when a metadata value in an update request would replace ALL metadata
+ * instead of being merged: `null` or an empty object. The base service only
+ * merges metadata that is non-empty, so these two erase what is stored.
+ */
+export function isEmptyMetadataUpdate(metadata: unknown): boolean {
+  return (
+    metadata === null ||
+    (typeof metadata === "object" &&
+      metadata !== undefined &&
+      Object.keys(metadata as object).length === 0)
+  )
+}
+
+/**
+ * Makes a plain product update safe for an existing bundle.
+ *
+ * - A `null` or `{}` metadata value is dropped, so it doesn't erase the bundle
+ *   marker. (Other keys are still merged by the base service, and a key can be
+ *   removed by setting it to an empty string, as for any product.)
+ * - Variants without an `id` would create a second variant, so the update is
+ *   rejected.
+ *
+ * Returns a copy; the input is not modified.
+ *
+ * @param update - one product's update data
+ * @param bundle - the existing bundle the update targets
+ */
+export function protectBundleUpdate<T extends Record<string, any>>(
+  update: T,
+  bundle: { id: string; title?: string | null }
+): T {
+  const variants = update.variants as { id?: string }[] | null | undefined
+
+  if (variants?.some((variant) => !variant.id)) {
+    throw new MedusaError(
+      MedusaError.Types.NOT_ALLOWED,
+      `A variant can't be added to the bundle "${bundle.title}" (${bundle.id}). A bundle has exactly one variant.`
+    )
+  }
+
+  // `mergeMetadata` deletes a key whose value is "" (and a null value would
+  // overwrite it), so naming the marker key with an empty value removes it.
+  // The HTTP validator already blocks the key, this protects direct workflow
+  // calls too. Setting real components is how the bundle workflows write it.
+  const metadata = update.metadata as Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined
+  if (
+    metadata &&
+    typeof metadata === "object" &&
+    BUNDLE_METADATA_KEY in metadata &&
+    (metadata[BUNDLE_METADATA_KEY] === "" ||
+      metadata[BUNDLE_METADATA_KEY] === null ||
+      metadata[BUNDLE_METADATA_KEY] === undefined)
+  ) {
+    throw new MedusaError(
+      MedusaError.Types.NOT_ALLOWED,
+      `The bundle marker of "${bundle.title}" (${bundle.id}) can't be removed. Delete the bundle instead.`
+    )
+  }
+
+  if (update.metadata !== undefined && isEmptyMetadataUpdate(update.metadata)) {
+    const { metadata: _dropped, ...rest } = update
+    return rest as T
+  }
+
+  return update
+}
+
+/**
+ * Throws when creating variants would give a bundle more than one variant.
+ * Creating a bundle itself is allowed: its product has no variants yet when its
+ * single variant is created.
+ *
+ * @param products - the products the variants are created for (with their
+ *   current variant count)
+ * @param newVariantsByProduct - how many variants the request adds per product
+ */
+export function assertBundleKeepsSingleVariant(
+  products: {
+    id: string
+    title?: string | null
+    metadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null
+    variantCount: number
+  }[],
+  newVariantsByProduct: Record<string, number>
+): void {
+  for (const product of products) {
+    if (!isBundleMetadata(product.metadata)) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (product.variantCount + (newVariantsByProduct[product.id] ?? 0) > 1) {
+      throw new MedusaError(
+        MedusaError.Types.NOT_ALLOWED,
+        `A variant can't be added to the bundle "${product.title}" (${product.id}). A bundle has exactly one variant.`
+      )
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+/**
+ * Throws when any of the variants belongs to a bundle. Deleting a bundle's
+ * variant would leave a bundle without a variant; delete the bundle instead.
+ */
+export function assertNoBundleVariants(
+  variants: {
+    id: string
+    product?: {
+      id: string
+      title?: string | null
+      metadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null
+    } | null
+  }[]
+): void {
+  const bundles = new Map<string, string | null | undefined>()
+
+  for (const variant of variants) {
+    if (variant.product && isBundleMetadata(variant.product.metadata)) {
+      bundles.set(variant.product.id, variant.product.title)
+    }
+  }
+
+  if (bundles.size) {
+    throw new MedusaError(
+      MedusaError.Types.NOT_ALLOWED,
+      `A variant of a bundle can't be deleted: ${[...bundles.entries()]
+        .map(([id, title]) => `"${title}" (${id})`)
+        .join(", ")}. Delete the bundle instead.`
+    )
+  }
+}
+
+/**
+ * Returns the id of a bundle's one variant. Throws if the bundle doesn't have
+ * exactly one, instead of silently picking the wrong variant.
+ */
+export function getBundleVariantId(product: {
+  id: string
+  variants?: { id: string }[] | null
+}): string {
+  if (product.variants?.length !== 1) {
+    throw new MedusaError(
+      MedusaError.Types.INVALID_DATA,
+      `Bundle ${product.id} has ${
+        product.variants?.length ?? 0
+      } variants but must have exactly 1.`
+    )
+  }
+
+  return product.variants[0].id
+}
```

```text
D6 (Sprint 3, individual, given 2026-11-16). Done for #62 (PR #115, see [[issue-62-design-decisions]]); the user needs it again for their next issue.

## Requirements
- Tool required (manual mutation doesn't count): StrykerJS with the Jest runner for Medusa. Mutate only source files changed by the PR. Commit the config used; credit a teammate if reusing their setup (reusing your own #62 setup is fine).
- Analyze every surviving mutant, plus NoCoverage ones (at least 10 if more than 10, PR-added/changed lines first): equivalent or test gap, and why.
- Add or strengthen at least one test that kills a gap survivor; re-run to confirm. If none are gaps, justify in the table.
- Evidence: JSON reports committed as docs/sprint3/mutation/reports/<issue>-njpiombino-before.json and -after.json. Scores must match the reports (score = killed+timeout / all mutants, NoCoverage counts against); the killed mutant must show Killed in "after".
- Submission: docs/sprint3/mutation/<issue>-njpiombino.md with template: title "# Mutation testing: Issue #<N> -- <title>"; header **PR(s):** **Tool:** **Config:** **Command:**; **Reports:** before/after links; **Mutation score:** before% -> after%; "## Surviving mutants" table | Location (file:line) | Mutation | Equivalent or test gap? | Why |; "## New or strengthened test" Commit · Test (file › name) · Kills; "## Questions" 1) what survivors revealed, 2) any survivor pointing to an assertion whose expected value wasn't from requirements, 3) AI use: what it produced and what was verified/corrected (or N/A). Q3 ends with a "Verified by me:" line the user supplies; the user must rerun Stryker themselves before submitting.
- The PR description's Test Evidence also links the D6 doc and gives the score (see [[pr-description-format]]).

## Working setup (from #62; reuse)
- Root dev deps already installed: `@stryker-mutator/core` and `@stryker-mutator/jest-runner` 10.1.1. `.gitignore` already ignores `.stryker-tmp` and `packages/modules/inventory/reports/mutation` (add the new package's reports dir).
- Config lives in the package dir: `packages/modules/inventory/stryker.config.json` + `stryker-build.cjs`. Copy both to the next package and change `mutate` (use a line range like `src/x.ts:443-553` to mutate only PR lines) and the file path in stryker-build.cjs. Run: `cd <package> && npx stryker run` with Postgres up (localhost:5433). About 7 min for 72 mutants and 48 tests.
- Key settings and why:
  - `testRunner: "jest"`, `jest.projectType: "custom"`, `configFile: "jest.config.js"`, a `testMatch` for the integration tests, `enableFindRelatedTests: false`.
  - Module integration tests load `dist/`, not `src/`, so `buildCommand` must rebuild after instrumentation. `buildCommand` is not run through a shell (`&&` breaks), so point it at a script.
  - `inPlace: true`: the sandbox copy breaks the package tsconfig's relative `extends`.
  - `coverageAnalysis: "all"`: `moduleIntegrationTestRunner` wraps suites in `describe("")`, so perTest coverage ids never match Jest test names and every mutant shows NoCoverage.
  - `concurrency: 1`: test runs share one DB name.
- Babel bug (both Stryker 10/Babel 8 and Stryker 9/Babel 7.29): instrumentation drops parameter decorators on params with a default value, so `@MedusaContext() context: Context = {}` loses its decorator and @EmitEvents tests fail in the initial run ("reading 'messageAggregator'"). `stryker-build.cjs` re-adds `@MedusaContext()` via regex before `yarn build`. Check that the target service uses the same `context: Context = {}` param name (some use `sharedContext`); adjust the regex if so.
- HTTP integration tests (`integration-tests/http`) can't be used: they boot a server against built packages. Mirror their cases as module-level tests so Stryker can see them.

## After each run
- Check `grep -c stryNS` in src and dist is 0. If dist is instrumented, rebuild the package (`yarn workspace <pkg> build`).
- Delete `src/migrations/.snapshot-*-integration-1.json`, which module test runs generate.
- Copy `reports/mutation/mutation.json` to the docs reports path; recompute scores from the JSON.
- A python snippet over `files[*].mutants` (status, location, replacement, and the source span) is the fastest way to list survivors with their original code.

## Typical #62 findings (for analysis)
Equivalent survivors were performance shortcuts (early returns on empty lists, narrowing a query to ids already filtered in memory, `select: ["id"]`). Real gaps were edge cases: first page with `take`, zero DB matches, caller's relations/select passed through, multiple invalid values in an error message. Removing equivalent shortcuts to raise the score was rejected (makes code worse).

**Why:** Graded deliverable that repeats for the next issue; setup took several failed runs to get right.
**How to apply:** Start from this recipe instead of rediscovering it; check the new package's test loader and decorator param names first.

Parent issue: #101.

Bundles ("Camera kit") are built on Medusa inventory kits: a bundle is a normal product/variant whose inventory items are the component variants' inventory items. No new data model, no migration.

Subissues (user wants exactly these 3, 2026-11-17; every owner requirement must be folded in, never cut; call oversized ones "medium"): (1) backend create/manage bundles, catalog fields, delete blocking, past orders, no migration - medium; (2) checkout and returns: named out-of-stock error, per-component refund shares saved at order placement, single-component returns backend, promos/tax/fulfillment as one item - medium, checkout-error part independent, rest blocked by 1; (3) admin UI incl. blocked-delete error and component picker in the return form - medium, blocked by 1 (and 2 for returns).

Owner answers (2026-11-17):
- Partial returns allowed. Refund share proportional to each component's normal price (camera 800 / lens 300 / bag 100 -> bag = 1/12 of bundle price). Shares must sum exactly to the bundle price after rounding. Admins can still override via existing custom refund amount (create-complete-return.ts validateCustomRefundAmount).
- Deleting a product or variant used in a bundle is blocked; error lists the bundles; admin must remove it from bundles first. Past orders with the bundle must keep working.
- Bundle behaves as a normal product in store API: own title, images, price, categories; shows on its own page and in category listings. Dedicated bundles page and upsells on component products are out of scope.

Proposed defaults (not vetoed): out of stock if any component is, quantity = min across components; bundle price fixed; per-region pricing via normal variant prices; promotions treat bundle as one item; taxed as one item; all components ship together.
```

```text
import type {
  BigNumberInput,
  IInventoryService,
} from "@medusajs/framework/types"
import {
  MathBN,
  MedusaError,
  Modules,
  promiseAll,
} from "@medusajs/framework/utils"
import { StepResponse, createStep } from "@medusajs/framework/workflows-sdk"

/**
 * The details of the cart items to confirm their inventory availability.
 */
export interface ConfirmVariantInventoryStepInput {
  /**
   * The items to confirm inventory for.
   */
  items: {
    /**
     * The ID of the inventory item associated with the line item's variant.
     */
    inventory_item_id: string
    /**
     * The number of units a single quantity is equivalent to. For example, if a customer orders one quantity of the variant, Medusa checks the availability of the quantity multiplied by the
     * value set for `required_quantity`. When the customer orders the quantity, Medusa reserves the ordered quantity multiplied by the value set for `required_quantity`.
     */
    required_quantity: number
    /**
     * Whether the variant can be ordered even if it's out of stock. If a variant has this enabled, the step doesn't throw an error.
     */
    allow_backorder: boolean
    /**
     * The quantity in the cart.
     */
    quantity: BigNumberInput
    /**
     * The ID of the stock locations that the inventory quantity is available in.
     */
    location_ids: string[]
  }[]
}

export const confirmInventoryStepId = "confirm-inventory-step"
/**
 * This step validates that items in the cart have sufficient inventory quantity.
 * If an item doesn't have sufficient inventory, an error is thrown.
 *
 * @example
 * confirmInventoryStep({
 *   items: [
 *     {
 *       inventory_item_id: "iitem_123",
 *       required_quantity: 1,
 *       allow_backorder: false,
 *       quantity: 1,
 *       location_ids: ["sloc_123"]
 *     }
 *   ]
 * })
 */
export const confirmInventoryStep = createStep(
  confirmInventoryStepId,
  async (data: ConfirmVariantInventoryStepInput, { container }) => {
    if (!data.items?.length) {
      return new StepResponse([], [])
    }

    const inventoryService = container.resolve<IInventoryService>(
      Modules.INVENTORY
    )

    // TODO: Should be bulk
    const promises = data.items.map(async (item) => {
      if (item.allow_backorder) {
        return true
      }

      const itemQuantity = MathBN.mult(item.quantity, item.required_quantity)

      return await inventoryService.confirmInventory(
        item.inventory_item_id,
        item.location_ids,
        itemQuantity
      )
    })

    const inventoryCoverage = await promiseAll(promises)

    if (inventoryCoverage.some((hasCoverage) => !hasCoverage)) {
      throw new MedusaError(
        MedusaError.Types.NOT_ALLOWED,
        `Some variant does not have the required inventory`,
        MedusaError.Codes.INSUFFICIENT_INVENTORY
      )
    }

    return new StepResponse(null)
  }
)
```

```text
import {
  BigNumberInput,
  ConfirmVariantInventoryWorkflowInputDTO,
} from "@medusajs/framework/types"
import {
  BigNumber,
  MathBN,
  MedusaError,
  deepFlatMap,
} from "@medusajs/framework/utils"

export const requiredOrderFieldsForInventoryConfirmation = [
  "id",
  "version",
  "canceled_at",
  "sales_channel_id",
  "items.*",
  "items.variant.manage_inventory",
  "items.variant.allow_backorder",
  "items.variant.inventory_items.inventory_item_id",
  "items.variant.inventory_items.required_quantity",
  "items.variant.inventory_items.inventory.location_levels.stocked_quantity",
  "items.variant.inventory_items.inventory.location_levels.reserved_quantity",
  "items.variant.inventory_items.inventory.location_levels.raw_stocked_quantity",
  "items.variant.inventory_items.inventory.location_levels.raw_reserved_quantity",
  "items.variant.inventory_items.inventory.location_levels.location_id",
  "items.variant.inventory_items.inventory.location_levels.stock_locations.id",
  "items.variant.inventory_items.inventory.location_levels.stock_locations.name",
  "items.variant.inventory_items.inventory.location_levels.stock_locations.sales_channels.id",
  "items.variant.inventory_items.inventory.location_levels.stock_locations.sales_channels.name",
]

export const requiredVariantFieldsForInventoryConfirmation = [
  "manage_inventory",
  "allow_backorder",
  "inventory_items.inventory_item_id",
  "inventory_items.required_quantity",
  "inventory_items.inventory.location_levels.stocked_quantity",
  "inventory_items.inventory.location_levels.reserved_quantity",
  "inventory_items.inventory.location_levels.raw_stocked_quantity",
  "inventory_items.inventory.location_levels.raw_reserved_quantity",
  "inventory_items.inventory.location_levels.location_id",
  "inventory_items.inventory.location_levels.stock_locations.id",
  "inventory_items.inventory.location_levels.stock_locations.name",
  "inventory_items.inventory.location_levels.stock_locations.sales_channels.id",
  "inventory_items.inventory.location_levels.stock_locations.sales_channels.name",
]

interface ConfirmInventoryPreparationInput {
  product_variant_inventory_items: {
    variant_id: string
    inventory_item_id: string
    required_quantity: number
  }[]
  items: {
    id?: string
    variant_id?: string | null
    quantity: BigNumberInput
  }[]
  variants: {
    id: string
    manage_inventory?: boolean
    allow_backorder?: boolean
  }[]
  location_ids: string[]
  stockAvailability: Map<string, Map<string, BigNumberInput>>
}

interface ConfirmInventoryItem {
  id?: string
  inventory_item_id: string
  required_quantity: number
  allow_backorder: boolean
  quantity: BigNumberInput
  location_ids: string[]
}

/**
 * This function prepares the input for the confirm inventory workflow.
 * In essesnce, it maps a list of cart items to a list of inventory items,
 * serving as a bridge between the cart and inventory domains.
 *
 * @throws {MedusaError} INVALID_DATA if any cart item is for a variant that has no inventory items.
 * @throws {MedusaError} INVALID_DATA if any cart item is for a variant with no stock locations in the input.sales_channel_id. An exception is made for variants with allow_backorder set to true.
 *
 * @returns {ConfirmInventoryPreparationInput}
 * A list of inventory items to confirm. Only inventory items for variants with managed inventory are included.
 */
export const prepareConfirmInventoryInput = (data: {
  input: ConfirmVariantInventoryWorkflowInputDTO
}) => {
  const productVariantInventoryItems = new Map<string, any>()
  const stockLocationIds = new Set<string>()
  const allVariants = new Map<string, any>()
  const mapLocationAvailability = new Map<string, Map<string, BigNumberInput>>()
  const variantsWithLocationForChannel = new Set<string>()
  let hasManagedInventory = false

  const salesChannelId = data.input.sales_channel_id

  for (const updateItem of data.input.itemsToUpdate ?? []) {
    const updateItem_ = "data" in updateItem ? updateItem.data : updateItem

    const item = data.input.items.find(
      (item) => item.variant_id === updateItem_.variant_id
    )
    if (item && updateItem_.quantity) {
      item.quantity = updateItem_.quantity!
    }
  }

  deepFlatMap(
    data.input,
    "variants.inventory_items.inventory.location_levels.stock_locations.sales_channels",
    ({
      variants,
      inventory_items,
      location_levels,
      stock_locations,
      sales_channels,
    }) => {
      if (!variants) {
        return
      }

      if (salesChannelId && sales_channels?.id === salesChannelId) {
        variantsWithLocationForChannel.add(variants.id)
      }

      if (location_levels && inventory_items) {
        const availability = MathBN.sub(
          location_levels.raw_stocked_quantity ??
            location_levels.stocked_quantity ??
            0,
          location_levels.raw_reserved_quantity ??
            location_levels.reserved_quantity ??
            0
        )

        if (!mapLocationAvailability.has(location_levels.location_id)) {
          mapLocationAvailability.set(location_levels.location_id, new Map())
        }

        const locationMap = mapLocationAvailability.get(
          location_levels.location_id
        )!
        locationMap.set(
          inventory_items.inventory_item_id,
          new BigNumber(availability)
        )
      }

      if (stock_locations && sales_channels?.id === salesChannelId) {
        stockLocationIds.add(stock_locations.id)
      }

      if (inventory_items) {
        const inventoryItemId = inventory_items.inventory_item_id
        const mapKey = `${inventoryItemId}-${inventory_items.variant_id}`

        if (!productVariantInventoryItems.has(mapKey)) {
          productVariantInventoryItems.set(mapKey, {
            variant_id: inventory_items.variant_id,
            inventory_item_id: inventoryItemId,
            required_quantity: inventory_items.required_quantity,
          })
        }
      }

      if (!allVariants.has(variants.id)) {
        if (!hasManagedInventory && variants.manage_inventory) {
          hasManagedInventory = true
        }

        allVariants.set(variants.id, {
          id: variants.id,
          manage_inventory: variants.manage_inventory,
          allow_backorder: variants.allow_backorder,
        })
      }
    }
  )

  if (!hasManagedInventory) {
    return { items: [] }
  }

  if (salesChannelId) {
    for (const variant of allVariants.values()) {
      if (
        variant.manage_inventory &&
        !variantsWithLocationForChannel.has(variant.id) &&
        !variant.allow_backorder
      ) {
        throw new MedusaError(
          MedusaError.Types.INVALID_DATA,
          `Sales channel ${salesChannelId} is not associated with any stock location for variant ${variant.id}.`
        )
      }
    }
  }

  const items = formatInventoryInput({
    product_variant_inventory_items: Array.from(
      productVariantInventoryItems.values()
    ),
    location_ids: Array.from(stockLocationIds),
    stockAvailability: mapLocationAvailability,
    items: data.input.items,
    variants: Array.from(allVariants.values()),
  })

  return { items }
}

const formatInventoryInput = ({
  product_variant_inventory_items,
  location_ids,
  items,
  stockAvailability,
  variants,
}: ConfirmInventoryPreparationInput) => {
  if (!product_variant_inventory_items.length) {
    return []
  }

  const variantsMap = new Map<
    string,
    ConfirmInventoryPreparationInput["variants"][0]
  >(variants.map((v) => [v.id, v]))

  const itemsToConfirm: ConfirmInventoryItem[] = []

  items.forEach((item) => {
    const variant = variantsMap.get(item.variant_id!)

    if (!variant?.manage_inventory) {
      return
    }

    const variantInventoryItems = product_variant_inventory_items.filter(
      (i) => i.variant_id === item.variant_id
    )

    if (!variantInventoryItems.length) {
      throw new MedusaError(
        MedusaError.Types.INVALID_DATA,
        `Variant ${item.variant_id} does not have any inventory items associated with it.`
      )
    }

    variantInventoryItems.forEach((variantInventoryItem) => {
      const locationsWithAvailability = location_ids.filter((locId) =>
        MathBN.gte(
          stockAvailability
            .get(locId)
            ?.get(variantInventoryItem.inventory_item_id) ?? 0,
          MathBN.mult(variantInventoryItem.required_quantity, item.quantity)
        )
      )

      const locationsWithLevel = location_ids.filter((locId) =>
        stockAvailability
          .get(locId)
          ?.has(variantInventoryItem.inventory_item_id)
      )

      itemsToConfirm.push({
        id: item.id,
        inventory_item_id: variantInventoryItem.inventory_item_id,
        required_quantity: variantInventoryItem.required_quantity,
        allow_backorder: !!variant.allow_backorder,
        quantity: item.quantity,

}
```

```text
  order: OrderDTO
```

```text
  }

  if (!locationId) {
    throw new MedusaError(
      MedusaError.Types.INVALID_DATA,
      `Cannot create return without stock location, either provide a location or you should link the shipping option ${returnShippingOption.id} to a stock location.`
    )
  }

  // delivery address is set to the stock location address
  const { id: _id, ...address } = returnShippingOption.service_zone.fulfillment_set.location?.address ?? {}

  return {
    input: {
      location_id: locationId,
      provider_id: returnShippingOption.provider_id,
      shipping_option_id: input.return_shipping?.option_id,
      items: fulfillmentItems,
      labels: input.return_shipping?.labels ?? [],
      delivery_address: address,
      order: order,
    },
  }
}

function prepareReturnShippingOptionQueryVariables({
  order,
  input,
  setPricingContextResult,
}: {
  order: {
    currency_code: string
    region_id?: string
  }
  input: {
    return_shipping?: OrderWorkflow.CreateOrderReturnWorkflowInput["return_shipping"]
  }
  setPricingContextResult?: any
}) {
  const variables = {
    id: input.return_shipping?.option_id,
    calculated_price: {
      context: {
        ...(setPricingContextResult ? setPricingContextResult : {}),
        currency_code: order.currency_code,
      },
    },
  }

  if (order.region_id) {
    variables.calculated_price.context["region_id"] = order.region_id
  }

  return variables
}

export type CreateCompleteReturnValidationStepInput = {
  order
  input: OrderWorkflow.CreateOrderReturnWorkflowInput
}

export const createCompleteReturnValidationStep = createStep(
  "create-complete-return-validation",
  async function (
    { order, input }: CreateCompleteReturnValidationStepInput,
    context
  ) {
    if (!input.items) {
      throw new MedusaError(
        MedusaError.Types.INVALID_DATA,
        `Items are required to create a return.`
      )
    }

    throwIfOrderIsCancelled({ order })
    throwIfItemsDoesNotExistsInOrder({ order, inputItems: input.items })
    await validateReturnReasons(
      { orderId: input.order_id, inputItems: input.items },
      context
    )
    validateCustomRefundAmount({ order, refundAmount: input.refund_amount })
  }
)
```

```text
import {
  ChangeActionType,
  MathBN,
  MedusaError,
} from "@medusajs/framework/utils"
import { OrderChangeProcessing } from "../calculate-order-change"
import { setActionReference } from "../set-action-reference"

OrderChangeProcessing.registerActionType(ChangeActionType.RETURN_ITEM, {
  isDeduction: true,
  operation({ action, currentOrder, options }) {
    const existing = currentOrder.items.find(
      (item) => item.id === action.details.reference_id
    )!

    existing.detail.return_requested_quantity ??= 0
    existing.detail.return_requested_quantity = MathBN.add(
      existing.detail.return_requested_quantity,
      action.details.quantity
    )

    setActionReference(existing, action, options)

    return MathBN.mult(existing.unit_price, action.details.quantity)
  },
  validate({ action, currentOrder }) {
    const refId = action.details?.reference_id
    if (refId == null) {
      throw new MedusaError(
        MedusaError.Types.INVALID_DATA,
        "Details reference ID is required."
      )
    }

    const existing = currentOrder.items.find((item) => item.id === refId)

    if (!existing) {
      throw new MedusaError(
        MedusaError.Types.INVALID_DATA,
        `Item ID "${refId}" not found.`
      )
    }

    if (!action.details?.quantity) {
      throw new MedusaError(
        MedusaError.Types.INVALID_DATA,
        `Quantity to return of item ${refId} is required.`
      )
    }

    const quantityAvailable = MathBN.sub(
      existing!.detail?.fulfilled_quantity ?? 0,
      existing!.detail?.return_requested_quantity ?? 0
    )

    const greater = MathBN.gt(action.details?.quantity, quantityAvailable)
    if (greater) {
      throw new MedusaError(
        MedusaError.Types.INVALID_DATA,
        `Cannot request to return more items than what was fulfilled for item ${refId}.`
      )
    }
  },
})
```

```text
  public processActions() {
    let newCreditLineTotal = (this.order.credit_lines ?? [])
      .filter((cl) => !("id" in cl))
      .reduce(
        (acc, creditLine) => MathBN.add(acc, creditLine.amount),
        MathBN.convert(0)
      )

    for (const action of this.actions) {
      this.processAction_(action)
    }

    const summary = this.summary

    for (const action of this.actions) {
      if (!this.isEventActive(action)) {
        continue
      }

      const type = {
        ...OrderChangeProcessing.defaultConfig,
        ...OrderChangeProcessing.typeDefinition[action.action],
      }

      const amount = MathBN.mult(action.amount!, type.isDeduction ? -1 : 1)

      if (action.change_id) {
        this.groupTotal[action.change_id] ??= 0
        this.groupTotal[action.change_id] = MathBN.add(
          this.groupTotal[action.change_id],
          amount
```

<tool-use data-tool-type="generic" data-tool-name="AskUserQuestion"><details>
<summary>Tool use: **AskUserQuestion**</summary>
**Issue #113, returning one item from a bundle (e.g. just the bag from a Camera kit): Medusa only knows how to return whole order line items, and the bundle is a single line item. Which approach should I take?**

Options:
- **Component return action (Recommended)** - A return line on the bundle item that names the component, with its refund set to the saved share. Medusa's order module return actions (request, receive, cancel) skip the bundle's own returned count for these, and receiving restocks only that component. This is the most changes in the order module, but the refund flows through normal order totals and history stays intact.
- **Fractional bundle quantity** - Returning the bag counts as returning 1/12 of a bundle. Fewer order module changes, but quantities shown in admin become fractions, precision rounding is needed, and restocking still needs custom code.
- **Unbundle on return** - First replace the bundle line with one line per component, priced at its share, then use the normal return flow unchanged. Reuses the most code, but rewrites order and fulfillment history, which is risky for past orders.

**Issue #113 refund shares: what amount gets split between a bundle's items when the order is placed?**

Options:
- **Total paid incl. tax (Recommended)** - Split the bundle line's final total after discounts and including tax, so returning every item refunds exactly what the shopper paid for the bundle.
- **Subtotal before tax** - Split the discounted price before tax, and refund tax separately through Medusa's normal tax handling. More accurate for tax reports, more code.

**Issue #113: for bundle orders placed before refund shares existed (no saved shares), what should a single-item return do?**

Options:
- **Reject with clear error (Recommended)** - Matches the draft acceptance criterion. Whole-bundle returns still work for those orders.
- **Compute shares at return time** - Use current component prices when the return is made. Works for old orders, but the refund depends on today's prices.

**Issue #113 requires that shoppers can only return their own orders, but Medusa's existing POST /store/returns needs no login: anyone with an order ID can create a return. How far should the fix go?**

Options:
- **Only for bundle-item returns (Recommended)** - Require a logged-in customer who owns the order only when the request returns a single bundle item. Existing guest returns keep working unchanged.
- **All store returns** - Require login and ownership for every store return. Closes the gap fully, but breaks guest-checkout returns, which existing storefronts may rely on.
- **Leave as is** - Note it as pre-existing tech debt and drop that part of the criterion.

```text
} from "@medusajs/framework/utils"
import { OrderChangeProcessing } from "../calculate-order-change"
import { setActionReference } from "../set-action-reference"

OrderChangeProcessing.registerActionType(ChangeActionType.RECEIVE_RETURN_ITEM, {
  isDeduction: true,
  operation({ action, currentOrder, previousEvents, options }) {
    const existing = currentOrder.items.find(
      (item) => item.id === action.details.reference_id
    )!

    let toReturn = action.details.quantity

    existing.detail.return_received_quantity ??= 0
    existing.detail.return_requested_quantity ??= 0

    existing.detail.return_received_quantity = MathBN.add(
      existing.detail.return_received_quantity,
      toReturn
    )
    existing.detail.return_requested_quantity = MathBN.sub(
      existing.detail.return_requested_quantity,
      toReturn
    )

    setActionReference(existing, action, options)

    return MathBN.mult(existing.unit_price, action.details.quantity)
  },
  validate({ action, currentOrder }) {
    const refId = action.details?.reference_id
    if (refId == null) {
      throw new MedusaError(
        MedusaError.Types.INVALID_DATA,
        "Details reference ID is required."
      )
    }

    const existing = currentOrder.items.find((item) => item.id === refId)

    if (!existing) {
      throw new MedusaError(
        MedusaError.Types.INVALID_DATA,
        `Item ID "${refId}" not found.`
      )
    }

    if (!action.details?.quantity) {
      throw new MedusaError(
        MedusaError.Types.INVALID_DATA,
        `Quantity to receive return of item ${refId} is required.`
      )
    }

    const quantityRequested = existing?.detail?.return_requested_quantity || 0

    const greater = MathBN.gt(action.details?.quantity, quantityRequested)
    if (greater) {
      throw new MedusaError(
        MedusaError.Types.INVALID_DATA,
        `Cannot receive more items than what was requested to be returned for item ${refId}.`
      )
    }
  },
})
```

```text
import {
  Context,
  CreateOrderChangeActionDTO,
  OrderTypes,
  ReturnDTO,
} from "@medusajs/framework/types"
import {
  ChangeActionType,
  promiseAll,
  ReturnStatus,
} from "@medusajs/framework/utils"

async function createOrderChange(
  service,
  data,
  returnRef,
  actions,
  sharedContext
) {
  return await service.createOrderChange_(
    {
      order_id: returnRef.order_id,
      return_id: returnRef.id,
      reference: "return",
      reference_id: returnRef.id,
      description: data.description,
      internal_note: data.internal_note,
      created_by: data.created_by,
      metadata: data.metadata,
      actions,
    },
    sharedContext
  )
}

export async function cancelReturn(
  this: any,
  data: OrderTypes.CancelOrderReturnDTO,
  sharedContext?: Context
) {
  const returnOrder = (await this.retrieveReturn(
    data.return_id,
    {
      select: [
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "items.item_id",
        "items.quantity",
        "items.received_quantity",
      ],
      relations: ["items", "shipping_methods"],
    },
    sharedContext
  )) as ReturnDTO

  const actions: CreateOrderChangeActionDTO[] = []

  returnOrder.items.forEach((item) => {
    actions.push({
      action: ChangeActionType.CANCEL_RETURN_ITEM,
      order_id: returnOrder.order_id,
      return_id: returnOrder.id,
      reference: "return",
      reference_id: returnOrder.id,
      details: {
        reference_id: item.item_id,
        quantity: item.quantity,
      },
    })
  })

  returnOrder.shipping_methods?.forEach((shipping) => {
    actions.push({
      action: ChangeActionType.SHIPPING_REMOVE,
      order_id: returnOrder.order_id,
      return_id: returnOrder.id,
      reference: "return",
      reference_id: shipping.id,
      amount: shipping.raw_amount ?? shipping.amount,
    })
  })

  const [change] = await createOrderChange(
    this,
    data,
    returnOrder,
    actions,
    sharedContext
  )

  await promiseAll([
    this.updateReturns(
      [
        {
          data: {
            canceled_at: new Date(),
            status: ReturnStatus.CANCELED,
          },
          selector: {
            id: returnOrder.id,
          },
        },
      ],
      sharedContext
    ),
    this.confirmOrderChange(change.id, sharedContext),
  ])

  return returnOrder
}
```

```text
import {
  CreateOrderReturnItemDTO,
  IOrderModuleService,
  OrderChangeActionDTO,
} from "@medusajs/framework/types"
import { Modules } from "@medusajs/framework/utils"
import { StepResponse, createStep } from "@medusajs/framework/workflows-sdk"

export type CreateReturnItemsFromActionsInput = {
  changes: OrderChangeActionDTO[]
  returnId: string
}

export const createReturnItemsFromActionsStep = createStep(
  "create-return-items-from-change-actions",
  async (input: CreateReturnItemsFromActionsInput, { container }) => {
    const orderModuleService = container.resolve<IOrderModuleService>(
      Modules.ORDER
    )

    const returnItems = input.changes.map((item) => {
      return {
        return_id: input.returnId,
        item_id: item.details?.reference_id! as string,
        reason_id: item.details?.reason_id,
        quantity: item.details?.quantity as number,
        note: item.internal_note,
        metadata: (item.details?.metadata as Record<string, unknown>) ?? {},
      } as CreateOrderReturnItemDTO
    })

    const createdReturnItems = await orderModuleService.createReturnItems(
      returnItems
    )

    return new StepResponse(
      createdReturnItems,
      createdReturnItems.map((i) => i.id)
    )
  },
  async (ids, { container }) => {
    if (!ids) {
      return
    }

    const orderModuleService = container.resolve<IOrderModuleService>(
      Modules.ORDER
    )

    await orderModuleService.deleteReturnItems(ids)
  }
)
```

```text
// Loop through the items in the return and prepare the inventory adjustment of items associated with each variant
function prepareInventoryUpdate({ orderReturn, returnedQuantityMap }) {
  const inventoryAdjustment: {
    inventory_item_id: string
    location_id: string
    adjustment: BigNumberInput
  }[] = []

  let hasManagedInventory = false
  let hasStockLocation = false

  const productVariantInventoryItems = new Map<string, any>()

  // Create the map of inventory item ids associated with each variant that have inventory management
  deepFlatMap(
    orderReturn.items,
    "item.variant.inventory_items.inventory.location_levels",
    ({ variant, inventory_items, location_levels }) => {
      if (!variant?.manage_inventory) {
        return
      }
      hasManagedInventory = true

      if (location_levels?.location_id !== orderReturn.location_id) {
        return
      }
      hasStockLocation = true

      if (!inventory_items) {
        return
      }

      const inventoryItemId = inventory_items.inventory_item_id

      if (!productVariantInventoryItems.has(inventoryItemId)) {
        productVariantInventoryItems.set(inventoryItemId, {
          variant_id: inventory_items.variant_id,
          inventory_item_id: inventoryItemId,
          required_quantity: inventory_items.required_quantity,
        })
      }
    }
  )

  if (hasManagedInventory && !hasStockLocation) {
    throw new Error(
      `Cannot receive the Return at location ${orderReturn.location_id}`
    )
  }

  // Adjust the inventory of all inventory items of each variant in the return
  for (const [variantId, quantity] of Object.entries(returnedQuantityMap)) {
    const inventoryItemsByVariant = Array.from(
      productVariantInventoryItems.values()
    ).filter((i) => i.variant_id === variantId)

    for (const inventoryItem of inventoryItemsByVariant) {
      inventoryAdjustment.push({
        inventory_item_id: inventoryItem.inventory_item_id,
        location_id: orderReturn.location_id,
        adjustment: MathBN.mult(
          quantity as number,
          inventoryItem.required_quantity
        ),
      })
    }
  }

  return inventoryAdjustment
}

/**
 * The data to confirm a return receival request.
export const confirmReturnReceiveWorkflow = createWorkflow(
  confirmReturnReceiveWorkflowId,
  function (
    input: ConfirmReceiveReturnRequestWorkflowInput
  ): WorkflowResponse<OrderPreviewDTO> {
    const orderReturn: ReturnDTO = useRemoteQueryStep({
      entry_point: "return",
      fields: [
        "id",
        "status",
        "order_id",
        "location_id",
        "canceled_at",
        "items.*",
        "items.item.variant_id",
        "items.item.variant.manage_inventory",
        "items.item.variant.inventory_items.inventory_item_id",
        "items.item.variant.inventory_items.required_quantity",
        "items.item.variant.inventory_items.inventory.location_levels.location_id",
      ],
      variables: { id: input.return_id },
      list: false,
      throw_if_key_not_found: true,
    })

    const order: OrderDTO = useRemoteQueryStep({
      entry_point: "orders",
      fields: ["id", "version", "canceled_at"],
      variables: { id: orderReturn.order_id },
      list: false,
      throw_if_key_not_found: true,
    }).config({ name: "order-query" })

    const orderChange: OrderChangeDTO = useRemoteQueryStep({
      entry_point: "order_change",
      fields: [
        "id",
        "status",
        "actions.id",
        "actions.action",
        "actions.details",
        "actions.reference",
        "actions.reference_id",
        "actions.internal_note",
      ],
      variables: {
        filters: {
          order_id: orderReturn.order_id,
          return_id: orderReturn.id,
          status: [OrderChangeStatus.PENDING, OrderChangeStatus.REQUESTED],
        },
      },
      list: false,
    }).config({ name: "order-change-query" })

    const { updateReturnItem, returnedQuantityMap, updateReturn } = transform(
      { orderChange, orderReturn },
      (data) => {
        const returnedQuantityMap: Record<string, BigNumberInput> = {}

        const retItems: OrderReturnItemDTO[] = data.orderReturn.items ?? []
        const received: OrderChangeActionDTO[] = []

        data.orderChange.actions.forEach((act) => {
          if (
            [
              ChangeActionType.RECEIVE_RETURN_ITEM,
              ChangeActionType.RECEIVE_DAMAGED_RETURN_ITEM,
            ].includes(act.action as ChangeActionType)
          ) {
            received.push(act)

            if (act.action === ChangeActionType.RECEIVE_RETURN_ITEM) {
              const itemId = act.details!.reference_id as string

              const variantId = (retItems as any).find(
                (i: any) => i.item_id === itemId
              )?.item?.variant_id

              if (!variantId) {
                return
              }

              const currentQuantity = returnedQuantityMap[variantId] ?? 0
              returnedQuantityMap[variantId] = MathBN.add(
                currentQuantity,
                act.details!.quantity as number
              )
            }
          }
        })

        const itemMap = retItems.reduce((acc, item: any) => {
          acc[item.item_id] = item.id
          return acc
        }, {})

        const itemUpdates = {}
        received.forEach((act) => {
          const itemId = act.details!.reference_id as string
          if (itemUpdates[itemId]) {
            itemUpdates[itemId].received_quantity = MathBN.add(
              itemUpdates[itemId].received_quantity,
              act.details!.quantity as BigNumberInput
            )

            if (act.action === ChangeActionType.RECEIVE_DAMAGED_RETURN_ITEM) {
              itemUpdates[itemId].damaged_quantity = MathBN.add(
                itemUpdates[itemId].damaged_quantity,
                act.details!.quantity as BigNumberInput
              )
            }

            return
          }

          itemUpdates[itemId] = {
            id: itemMap[itemId],
            received_quantity: act.details!.quantity,
            damaged_quantity:
              act.action === ChangeActionType.RECEIVE_DAMAGED_RETURN_ITEM
                ? act.details!.quantity
                : 0,
          }
        })

        const hasReceivedAllItems = retItems.every((item) => {
          const received = itemUpdates[item.item_id]
            ? itemUpdates[item.item_id].received_quantity
            : item.received_quantity

          return MathBN.eq(received, item.quantity)
        })
        const updateReturnData = hasReceivedAllItems
          ? { status: ReturnStatus.RECEIVED, received_at: new Date() }
          : { status: ReturnStatus.PARTIALLY_RECEIVED }

        const updateReturn = {
          id: data.orderReturn.id,
          ...updateReturnData,
        }

        return {
          updateReturnItem: Object.values(itemUpdates) as any,
          returnedQuantityMap,
          updateReturn,
        }
      }
    )

    const inventoryAdjustment = transform(
      { orderReturn, input, returnedQuantityMap },
      prepareInventoryUpdate
    )

    confirmReceiveReturnValidationStep({ order, orderReturn, orderChange })

    const [, , , adjustedLevels] = parallelize(
      updateReturnsStep([updateReturn]),
      updateReturnItemsStep(updateReturnItem),
      confirmOrderChanges({
        changes: [orderChange],
        orderId: order.id,
        confirmed_by: input.confirmed_by,
      }),
      adjustInventoryLevelsStep(inventoryAdjustment)
    )

    const levelUpdatedEvents = transform(
      { adjustedLevels, order },
      ({ adjustedLevels, order }) => {
        return adjustedLevels.map((level) => ({
          id: level.id,
          order_id: order.id,
        }))
      }
    )

    parallelize(
      createOrUpdateOrderPaymentCollectionWorkflow.runAsStep({
        input: {
          order_id: order.id,
        },
      }),
      emitEventStep({
        eventName: OrderWorkflowEvents.RETURN_RECEIVED,
        data: {
          order_id: order.id,
          return_id: orderReturn.id,
        },
      }),
      emitEventStep({
        eventName: InventoryLevelWorkflowEvents.UPDATED,
        data: levelUpdatedEvents,
      }).config({ name: "emit-inventory-level-updated" })
    )

    return new WorkflowResponse(previewOrderChangeStep(order.id))
  }
)
```

```text
import { MathBN, Modules } from "@medusajs/framework/utils"
import { createStep, StepResponse } from "@medusajs/framework/workflows-sdk"
import type { BigNumberInput } from "@medusajs/framework/types"

/**
 * The details of the items and their quantity to reserve.
 */
export interface ReserveVariantInventoryStepInput {
  items: {
    /**
     * The ID for the line item.
     */
    id?: string

    /**
     * The ID of the inventory item to reserve quantities from.
     */
    inventory_item_id: string

    /**
     * The number of units a single quantity is equivalent to. For example, if a customer orders one quantity of the variant, Medusa checks the availability of the quantity multiplied by the
     * value set for `required_quantity`. When the customer orders the quantity, Medusa reserves the ordered quantity multiplied by the value set for `required_quantity`.
     */
    required_quantity: number

    /**
     * Whether the variant can be ordered even if it's out of stock.
     */
    allow_backorder: boolean

    /**
     * The quantity to reserve.
     */
    quantity: BigNumberInput

    /**
     * The IDs of stock locations to reserve the item's quantity in.
     */
    location_ids: string[]
  }[]
}

export const reserveInventoryStepId = "reserve-inventory-step"
/**
 * This step reserves the quantity of line items from the associated
 * variant's inventory.
 *
 * @example
 * const data = reserveInventoryStep({
 *   "items": [{
 *     "inventory_item_id": "iitem_123",
 *     "required_quantity": 1,
 *     "allow_backorder": false,
 *     "quantity": 1,
 *     "location_ids": [
 *       "sloc_123"
 *     ]
 *   }]
 * })
 */
export const reserveInventoryStep = createStep(
  reserveInventoryStepId,
  async (data: ReserveVariantInventoryStepInput, { container }) => {
    if (!data.items.length) {
      return new StepResponse([], {
        reservations: [],
        inventoryItemIds: [],
      })
    }

    const inventoryService = container.resolve(Modules.INVENTORY)
    const locking = container.resolve(Modules.LOCKING)

    const inventoryItemIds: string[] = []

    const items = data.items.map((item) => {
      inventoryItemIds.push(item.inventory_item_id)

      return {
        line_item_id: item.id,
        inventory_item_id: item.inventory_item_id,
        quantity: MathBN.mult(item.required_quantity, item.quantity),
        allow_backorder: item.allow_backorder,
        location_id: item.location_ids[0],
      }
    })

    const lockingKeys = Array.from(new Set(inventoryItemIds))

    const reservations = await locking.execute(lockingKeys, async () => {
      return await inventoryService.createReservationItems(items)
    })

    return new StepResponse(reservations, {
      reservations: reservations.map((r) => r.id),
      inventoryItemIds,
    })
  },
  async (data, { container }) => {
    if (!data?.reservations?.length) {
      return
    }

    const inventoryService = container.resolve(Modules.INVENTORY)
    const locking = container.resolve(Modules.LOCKING)

    const inventoryItemIds = data.inventoryItemIds
    const lockingKeys = Array.from(new Set(inventoryItemIds))

    await locking.execute(lockingKeys, async () => {
      await inventoryService.deleteReservationItems(data.reservations)
    })

    return new StepResponse()
  }
)
```

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-11-17 19:38:24Z)**_

<tool-use data-tool-type="write" data-tool-name="Write"><details>
<summary>Tool use: **Write**</summary>

```typescript
import type { BigNumberInput, MedusaContainer } from "@medusajs/framework/types"
import {
  ContainerRegistrationKeys,
  MathBN,
  MedusaError,
  Modules,
} from "@medusajs/framework/utils"

/**
 * A cart or order line whose inventory item doesn't have enough stock.
 */
export type ShortInventoryItem = {
  /**
   * The ID of the inventory item without enough stock.
   */
  inventory_item_id: string
  /**
   * The ID of the line item's variant. For a bundle, this is the bundle's variant.
   */
  variant_id?: string | null
}

/**
 * A variant with the data needed to name it in an error message.
 */
export type NamedVariant = {
  id: string
  title?: string | null
  product?: {
    title?: string | null
    metadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null
    variants?: { id: string }[] | null
  } | null
  inventory_items?: { inventory_item_id: string }[] | null
}

/**
 * One out-of-stock entry: the bundle it belongs to (if any) and the name of
 * the variant that is out of stock.
 */
export type InventoryShortage = {
  bundle?: string | null
  name: string
}

const GENERIC_MESSAGE = "Some variant does not have the required inventory"

/**
 * Names a variant the way a shopper sees it: the product title, plus the
 * variant title when the product has more than one variant.
 */
export function getVariantDisplayName(variant: NamedVariant): string {
  const productTitle = variant.product?.title
  const variantTitle = variant.title

  if (!productTitle) {
    return variantTitle ?? variant.id
  }

  const hasSeveralVariants = (variant.product?.variants?.length ?? 0) > 1
  if (hasSeveralVariants && variantTitle && variantTitle !== productTitle) {
    return `${productTitle} (${variantTitle})`
  }

  return productTitle
}

function getBundleComponentIds(variant?: NamedVariant): string[] | null {
  const components = (
    variant?.product?.metadata?.bundle as
      | { components?: { variant_id: string }[] }
      | undefined
  )?.components

  return Array.isArray(components)
    ? components.map((component) => component.variant_id)
    : null
}

/**
 * Works out which products are out of stock.
 *
 * - For a normal line, the line's own variant is named.
 * - For a bundle line, the bundle's components that use the short inventory
 *   item are named, together with the bundle.
 *
 * Each shortage is listed once, even if several lines report it.
 *
 * @param shortItems - the lines and inventory items without enough stock
 * @param variants - the line items' variants, and every bundle component variant
 */
export function resolveInventoryShortages(
  shortItems: ShortInventoryItem[],
  variants: NamedVariant[]
): InventoryShortage[] {
  const variantsById = new Map(variants.map((variant) => [variant.id, variant]))
  const shortages = new Map<string, InventoryShortage>()

  const add = (shortage: InventoryShortage) => {
    shortages.set(`${shortage.bundle ?? ""}\u0000${shortage.name}`, shortage)
  }

  for (const item of shortItems) {
    const lineVariant = item.variant_id
      ? variantsById.get(item.variant_id)
      : undefined
    if (!lineVariant) {
      continue
    }

    const componentIds = getBundleComponentIds(lineVariant)
    if (!componentIds) {
      add({ name: getVariantDisplayName(lineVariant) })
      continue
    }

    const bundleName = getVariantDisplayName(lineVariant)
    const components = componentIds
      .map((id) => variantsById.get(id))
      .filter((component) =>
        component?.inventory_items?.some(
          (link) => link.inventory_item_id === item.inventory_item_id
        )
      ) as NamedVariant[]

    if (!components.length) {
      // The bundle changed since its components were saved: name the bundle.
      add({ name: bundleName })
      continue
    }

    for (const component of components) {
      add({ bundle: bundleName, name: getVariantDisplayName(component) })
    }
  }

  return [...shortages.values()]
}

/**
 * Builds the error message for out-of-stock items, grouped by bundle.
 *
 * @example
 * formatInsufficientInventoryMessage([
 *   { bundle: "Camera kit", name: "Lens" },
 *   { name: "T-shirt (L)" },
 * ])
 * // "Camera kit: Lens is out of stock. T-shirt (L) is out of stock."
 */
export function formatInsufficientInventoryMessage(
  shortages: InventoryShortage[]
): string {
  if (!shortages.length) {
    return GENERIC_MESSAGE
  }

  const groups = new Map<string, string[]>()
  for (const shortage of shortages) {
    const key = shortage.bundle ?? ""
    groups.set(key, [...(groups.get(key) ?? []), shortage.name])
  }

  const sentences: string[] = []
  for (const [bundle, names] of groups) {
    const verb = names.length > 1 ? "are" : "is"
    const list = names.join(", ")

    if (bundle) {
      sentences.push(`${bundle}: ${list} ${verb} out of stock.`)
    } else {
      for (const name of names) {
        sentences.push(`${name} is out of stock.`)
      }
    }
  }

  return sentences.join(" ")
}

/**
 * Loads the names of the out-of-stock products and returns the error to throw.
 * It only runs when stock is missing, so the extra queries don't slow down a
 * normal checkout.
 */
export async function buildInsufficientInventoryError(
  container: MedusaContainer,
  shortItems: ShortInventoryItem[]
): Promise<MedusaError> {
  const query = container.resolve(ContainerRegistrationKeys.QUERY)
  const fields = [
    "id",
    "title",
    "product.title",
    "product.metadata",
    "product.variants.id",
    "inventory_items.inventory_item_id",
  ]

  const lineVariantIds = [
    ...new Set(
      shortItems.map((item) => item.variant_id).filter(Boolean) as string[]
    ),
  ]

  let variants: NamedVariant[] = []
  if (lineVariantIds.length) {
    const { data } = await query.graph({
      entity: "variant",
      fields,
      filters: { id: lineVariantIds },
    })
    variants = data as NamedVariant[]

    const componentIds = [
      ...new Set(variants.flatMap((v) => getBundleComponentIds(v) ?? [])),
    ].filter((id) => !lineVariantIds.includes(id))

    if (componentIds.length) {
      const { data: components } = await query.graph({
        entity: "variant",
        fields,
        filters: { id: componentIds },
      })
      variants = variants.concat(components as NamedVariant[])
    }
  }

  return new MedusaError(
    MedusaError.Types.NOT_ALLOWED,
    formatInsufficientInventoryMessage(
      resolveInventoryShortages(shortItems, variants)
    ),
    MedusaError.Codes.INSUFFICIENT_INVENTORY
  )
}

/**
 * Finds the reservation lines that can't be covered by stock. Quantities of the
 * same inventory item at the same location are added up first, so a bundle and
 * a separate line for one of its components are checked together.
 */
export async function findShortReservationItems<
  T extends {
    inventory_item_id: string
    location_id?: string
    quantity: BigNumberInput
    allow_backorder?: boolean
  }
>(container: MedusaContainer, items: T[]): Promise<T[]> {
  const inventoryService = container.resolve(Modules.INVENTORY)

  const totals = new Map<string, { item: T; quantity: BigNumberInput }>()
  for (const item of items) {
    if (item.allow_backorder) {
      continue
    }
    const key = `${item.inventory_item_id}\u0000${item.location_id ?? ""}`
    const current = totals.get(key)
    totals.set(key, {
      item,
      quantity: current
        ? MathBN.add(current.quantity, item.quantity)
        : item.quantity,
    })
  }

  const shortKeys = new Set<string>()
  for (const [key, { item, quantity }] of totals) {
    const hasStock = await inventoryService.confirmInventory(
      item.inventory_item_id,
      item.location_id ? [item.location_id] : [],
      quantity
    )
    if (!hasStock) {
      shortKeys.add(key)
    }
  }

  return items.filter((item) =>
    shortKeys.has(`${item.inventory_item_id}\u0000${item.location_id ?? ""}`)
  )
}
```
