```typescript
import type { BigNumberInput } from "@medusajs/framework/types"
import { MathBN, MedusaError } from "@medusajs/framework/utils"

/*
 * Refund shares and single-item returns for product bundles (issue #113).
 *
 * When an order with a bundle is placed, each component's share of what was
 * paid for the bundle line is saved in the order line item's
 * `metadata.bundle.components`. A return can then name one component of the
 * bundle line (`component_variant_id`); its refund comes from that saved share
 * and only that component goes back into stock.
 *
 * Everything in this file is a pure function so it can be unit tested.
 */

/**
 * Key in a line item's metadata where the bundle components are saved, and in
 * a return item's or order change action's metadata where the returned
 * component is named.
 */
export const BUNDLE_LINE_METADATA_KEY = "bundle"
export const BUNDLE_COMPONENT_METADATA_KEY = "bundle_component"

/**
 * One component of a bundle line item, as saved on the order.
 */
export type OrderBundleComponent = {
  variant_id: string
  title: string
  /**
   * How many of the component are in one bundle.
   */
  quantity: number
  /**
   * How many of the component the whole line holds (line quantity x quantity).
   */
  units: number
  /**
   * The component's share of what was paid for the whole line.
   */
  refund_share: number
  /**
   * The component variant's inventory links, used to restock only this
   * component when it's returned.
   */
  inventory_items: { inventory_item_id: string; required_quantity: number }[]
}

/**
 * The returned component, saved on a return item and its order change actions.
 */
export type ReturnedBundleComponent = {
  variant_id: string
  title: string
  /**
   * The refund for this action (or, on a return item, for its full quantity).
   */
  amount: number
}

const toMinorUnits = (amount: BigNumberInput, precision: number): bigint => {
  const scaled = MathBN.mult(amount, Math.pow(10, precision))
  return BigInt(MathBN.convert(scaled).decimalPlaces(0).toFixed())
}

const fromMinorUnits = (amount: bigint, precision: number): number =>
  Number(amount) / Math.pow(10, precision)

/**
 * Splits what was paid for a bundle line between its components.
 *
 * Each component's share is `price x quantity / (sum over all components)`
 * of the amount paid. If any component has no price (for example none in the
 * order's currency), or every price is 0, the amount is split by quantity
 * instead.
 *
 * Shares are rounded to the currency's smallest unit and always add up exactly
 * to the amount paid: each share is rounded down, and the cents left over go
 * one each to the components with the largest remainders (the earlier
 * component wins a tie), so the same order always gives the same shares.
 *
 * @param components - the bundle's components, each with its normal unit price
 * @param lineQuantity - how many bundles the line holds
 * @param amountPaid - the line's total after discounts and including tax
 * @param precision - the currency's number of decimal digits
 */
export function computeBundleRefundShares({
  components,
  lineQuantity,
  amountPaid,
  precision,
}: {
  components: {
    variant_id: string
    title: string
    quantity: number
    unit_price?: BigNumberInput | null
    inventory_items: OrderBundleComponent["inventory_items"]
  }[]
  lineQuantity: number
  amountPaid: BigNumberInput
  precision: number
}): OrderBundleComponent[] {
  const pricesKnown = components.every(
    (component) => component.unit_price != null
  )

  let weights = components.map((component) =>
    pricesKnown
      ? toMinorUnits(component.unit_price!, precision) *
        BigInt(component.quantity)
      : BigInt(component.quantity)
  )
  if (weights.every((weight) => weight === 0n)) {
    weights = components.map((component) => BigInt(component.quantity))
  }

  const totalWeight = weights.reduce((sum, weight) => sum + weight, 0n)
  const total = toMinorUnits(amountPaid, precision)

  const shares = weights.map((weight) => (total * weight) / totalWeight)
  const remainders = weights.map((weight, i) => ({
    i,
    remainder: total * weight - shares[i] * totalWeight,
  }))

  let leftover = total - shares.reduce((sum, share) => sum + share, 0n)
  remainders.sort((a, b) =>
    a.remainder === b.remainder ? a.i - b.i : a.remainder > b.remainder ? -1 : 1
  )
  for (const { i } of remainders) {
    if (leftover <= 0n) {
      break
    }
    shares[i] += 1n
    leftover -= 1n
  }

  return components.map((component, i) => ({
    variant_id: component.variant_id,
    title: component.title,
    quantity: component.quantity,
    units: component.quantity * lineQuantity,
    refund_share: fromMinorUnits(shares[i], precision),
    inventory_items: component.inventory_items,
  }))
}

/**
 * The refund for returning `quantity` more units of a component when
 * `previousUnits` were already returned.
 *
 * The share is spread over its units by rounding the running total down, so
 * any number of partial returns adds up exactly to the share once every unit is
 * returned.
 */
export function allocateComponentRefund({
  share,
  units,
  previousUnits,
  quantity,
  precision,
}: {
  share: BigNumberInput
  units: number
  previousUnits: number
  quantity: number
  precision: number
}): number {
  const total = toMinorUnits(share, precision)
  const upTo = (n: number) => (total * BigInt(n)) / BigInt(units)

  return fromMinorUnits(
    upTo(previousUnits + quantity) - upTo(previousUnits),
    precision
  )
}

/**
 * Reads the bundle components saved on an order line item. Returns `null` for
 * a line that isn't a bundle or was ordered before shares were saved.
 */
export function getOrderBundleComponents(
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null
): OrderBundleComponent[] | null {
  const components = (
    metadata?.[BUNDLE_LINE_METADATA_KEY] as
      | { components?: OrderBundleComponent[] }
      | undefined
  )?.components

  return Array.isArray(components) &&
    components.every((component) => component.refund_share != null)
    ? components
    : null
}

/**
 * Reads the returned component saved on a return item or an action.
 */
export function getReturnedBundleComponent(
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null
): ReturnedBundleComponent | null {
  const component = metadata?.[BUNDLE_COMPONENT_METADATA_KEY] as
    | ReturnedBundleComponent
    | undefined

  return component?.variant_id ? component : null
}

/**
 * An order line item with the fields the return checks need.
 */
export type BundleReturnOrderItem = {
  id: string
  title?: string | null
  quantity: BigNumberInput
  fulfilled_quantity?: BigNumberInput | null
  return_requested_quantity?: BigNumberInput | null
  return_received_quantity?: BigNumberInput | null
  return_dismissed_quantity?: BigNumberInput | null
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null
}

/**
 * A component or whole-line return that already exists (a return item of a
 * return that isn't canceled, or a pending return action).
 */
export type ExistingBundleReturn = {
  item_id: string
  quantity: BigNumberInput
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null
}

/**
 * An item of a return request, as sent by the client.
 */
export type BundleReturnRequestItem = {
  id: string
  quantity: BigNumberInput
  component_variant_id?: string | null
  metadata?: Record<string, any> | null
}

const toNumber = (value?: BigNumberInput | null) =>
  MathBN.convert(value ?? 0).toNumber()

/**
 * Checks a return request against the bundles in the order and prepares the
 * items for the return workflows:
 *
 * - an item with `component_variant_id` returns that component of a bundle
 *   line. Its metadata names the component and its refund amount.
 * - an item of a bundle line without `component_variant_id` returns whole
 *   bundles, which is only allowed for bundles none of whose components were
 *   returned.
 *
 * Items of lines that aren't bundles are returned unchanged.
 *
 * @throws {MedusaError} INVALID_DATA when a component isn't in the bundle, the
 * line isn't a bundle, the order was placed before shares were saved, or more
 * is returned than is left.
 */
export function prepareBundleReturnItems<T extends BundleReturnRequestItem>({
  items,
  orderItems,
  existingReturns,
  precision,
}: {
  items: T[]
  orderItems: BundleReturnOrderItem[]
  existingReturns: ExistingBundleReturn[]
  precision: number
}): (Omit<T, "component_variant_id"> & { metadata?: Record<string, any> | null })[] {
  const orderItemsById = new Map(orderItems.map((item) => [item.id, item]))

  // Units of each component (key: line + variant) and whole bundles per line
  // that are already being returned, including the ones in this request.
  const componentUnits = new Map<string, number>()
  const wholeBundles = new Map<string, number>()
  const key = (itemId: string, variantId: string) => `${itemId}\u0000${variantId}`

  for (const existing of existingReturns) {
    const component = getReturnedBundleComponent(existing.metadata)
    if (component) {
      const k = key(existing.item_id, component.variant_id)
      componentUnits.set(
        k,
        (componentUnits.get(k) ?? 0) + toNumber(existing.quantity)
      )
    }
  }

  const bundlesTouchedByComponents = (
    itemId: string,
    components: OrderBundleComponent[]
  ) =>
    Math.max(
      0,
      ...components.map((component) =>
        Math.ceil(
          (componentUnits.get(key(itemId, component.variant_id)) ?? 0) /
            component.quantity
        )
      )
    )

  return items.map((item) => {
    const { component_variant_id: componentVariantId, ...rest } = item
    const orderItem = orderItemsById.get(item.id)
    const savedComponents = orderItem
      ? getOrderBundleComponents(orderItem.metadata)
      : null
    const isBundleLine = !!orderItem?.metadata?.[BUNDLE_LINE_METADATA_KEY]
    const quantity = toNumber(item.quantity)

    if (!orderItem || (!componentVariantId && !isBundleLine)) {
      return rest
    }

    // Bundles already out of the customer's hands as whole bundles: requested,
    // received or dismissed returns of the line, plus earlier items of this
    // request.
    const wholeTaken =
      toNumber(orderItem.return_requested_quantity) +
      toNumber(orderItem.return_received_quantity) +
      toNumber(orderItem.return_dismissed_quantity) +
      (wholeBundles.get(item.id) ?? 0)
    const fulfilled = toNumber(orderItem.fulfilled_quantity)

    if (!componentVariantId) {
      // A whole-bundle return of a bundle line.
      if (savedComponents) {
        const available =
          fulfilled - wholeTaken - bundlesTouchedByComponents(item.id, savedComponents)
        if (quantity > available) {
          throw new MedusaError(
            MedusaError.Types.INVALID_DATA,
            `Cannot return ${quantity} of the bundle "${orderItem.title}": only ${Math.max(
              available,
              0
            )} can be returned whole, because items of the other bundles were already returned. Return the remaining items individually instead.`
          )
        }
      }
      wholeBundles.set(item.id, (wholeBundles.get(item.id) ?? 0) + quantity)
      return rest
    }

    if (!isBundleLine) {
      throw new MedusaError(
        MedusaError.Types.INVALID_DATA,
        `Item ${item.id} is not a bundle, so a component can't be returned from it.`
      )
    }

    if (!savedComponents) {
      throw new MedusaError(
        MedusaError.Types.INVALID_DATA,
        `The bundle "${orderItem.title}" was ordered before single items could be returned. Return the whole bundle instead.`
      )
    }

    const component = savedComponents.find(
      (c) => c.variant_id === componentVariantId
    )
    if (!component) {
      throw new MedusaError(
        MedusaError.Types.INVALID_DATA,
        `Variant ${componentVariantId} is not part of the bundle "${orderItem.title}".`
      )
    }

    const k = key(item.id, component.variant_id)
    const previousUnits = componentUnits.get(k) ?? 0
    const available =
      (fulfilled - wholeTaken) * component.quantity - previousUnits
    if (quantity > available) {
      throw new MedusaError(
        MedusaError.Types.INVALID_DATA,
        `Cannot return ${quantity} of "${component.title}" from the bundle "${orderItem.title}": only ${Math.max(
          available,
          0
        )} can be returned.`
      )
    }

    componentUnits.set(k, previousUnits + quantity)

    return {
      ...rest,
      metadata: {
        ...(item.metadata ?? {}),
        [BUNDLE_COMPONENT_METADATA_KEY]: {
          variant_id: component.variant_id,
          title: component.title,
          amount: allocateComponentRefund({
            share: component.refund_share,
            units: component.units,
            previousUnits,
            quantity,
            precision,
          }),
        } satisfies ReturnedBundleComponent,
      },
    }
  })
}

/**
 * A return item of a component return, with how much of it was received.
 */
export type ComponentReturnItem = {
  item_id: string
  quantity: BigNumberInput
  received_quantity?: BigNumberInput | null
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null
}

/**
 * Prepares the receive (or dismiss) items of a return. An item with
 * `component_variant_id` receives that component's return item. Its metadata
 * names the component and the part of the return item's refund the received
 * quantity stands for, spread the same way as `allocateComponentRefund`.
 *
 * @throws {MedusaError} INVALID_DATA when the return has no such component or
 * more is received than was returned.
 */
export function prepareBundleReceiveItems<T extends BundleReturnRequestItem>({
  items,
  returnItems,
  pendingReceived,
  precision,
}: {
  items: T[]
  returnItems: ComponentReturnItem[]
  /**
   * Quantities already received in the pending receive change, per return item
   * (key: item ID + component variant ID).
   */
  pendingReceived?: Record<string, number>
  precision: number
}): (Omit<T, "component_variant_id"> & { metadata?: Record<string, any> | null })[] {
  const received = new Map<string, number>(Object.entries(pendingReceived ?? {}))

  return items.map((item) => {
    const { component_variant_id: componentVariantId, ...rest } = item
    if (!componentVariantId) {
      return rest
    }

    const returnItem = returnItems.find(
      (candidate) =>
        candidate.item_id === item.id &&
        getReturnedBundleComponent(candidate.metadata)?.variant_id ===
          componentVariantId
    )
    const component = returnItem
      ? getReturnedBundleComponent(returnItem.metadata)!
      : null
    if (!returnItem || !component) {
      throw new MedusaError(
        MedusaError.Types.INVALID_DATA,
        `The return has no item for variant ${componentVariantId} of item ${item.id}.`
      )
    }

    const k = bundleReturnItemKey(item.id, returnItem.metadata)
    const units = toNumber(returnItem.quantity)
    const previousUnits =
      toNumber(returnItem.received_quantity) + (received.get(k) ?? 0)
    const quantity = toNumber(item.quantity)

    if (previousUnits + quantity > units) {
      throw new MedusaError(
        MedusaError.Types.INVALID_DATA,
        `Cannot receive more of "${component.title}" than was returned.`
      )
    }
    received.set(k, (received.get(k) ?? 0) + quantity)

    return {
      ...rest,
      metadata: {
        ...(item.metadata ?? {}),
        [BUNDLE_COMPONENT_METADATA_KEY]: {
          variant_id: component.variant_id,
          title: component.title,
          amount: allocateComponentRefund({
            share: component.amount,
            units,
            previousUnits,
            quantity,
            precision,
          }),
        } satisfies ReturnedBundleComponent,
      },
    }
  })
}

/**
 * Identifies a return item: the order line item, plus the returned component
 * for a component return. Two components of the same bundle line are separate
 * return items.
 */
export function bundleReturnItemKey(
  itemId: string,
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null
): string {
  const component = getReturnedBundleComponent(metadata)
  return component ? `${itemId}\u0000${component.variant_id}` : itemId
}

/**
 * The inventory to put back for received component returns: only the returned
 * component's inventory items, never the rest of the bundle.
 */
export function getComponentRestockAdjustments({
  received,
  orderItems,
}: {
  received: { item_id: string; quantity: BigNumberInput; variant_id: string }[]
  orderItems: { id: string; metadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null }[]
}): { inventory_item_id: string; adjustment: BigNumberInput }[] {
  const adjustments = new Map<string, BigNumberInput>()

  for (const entry of received) {
    const orderItem = orderItems.find((item) => item.id === entry.item_id)
    const component = getOrderBundleComponents(orderItem?.metadata)?.find(
      (c) => c.variant_id === entry.variant_id
    )

    for (const link of component?.inventory_items ?? []) {
      adjustments.set(
        link.inventory_item_id,
        MathBN.add(
          adjustments.get(link.inventory_item_id) ?? 0,
          MathBN.mult(entry.quantity, link.required_quantity)
        )
      )
    }
  }

  return [...adjustments.entries()].map(([inventory_item_id, adjustment]) => ({
    inventory_item_id,
    adjustment,
  }))
}
```

```text
import {
  ChangeActionType,
  MathBN,
  MedusaError,
} from "@medusajs/framework/utils"
import { OrderChangeProcessing } from "../calculate-order-change"
import { setActionReference } from "../set-action-reference"

OrderChangeProcessing.registerActionType(ChangeActionType.CANCEL_RETURN_ITEM, {
  operation({ action, currentOrder, options }) {
    const existing = currentOrder.items.find(
      (item) => item.id === action.details.reference_id
    )!

    existing.detail.return_requested_quantity ??= 0

    existing.detail.return_requested_quantity = MathBN.sub(
      existing.detail.return_requested_quantity,
      action.details.quantity
    )

    setActionReference(existing, action, options)

    return MathBN.mult(existing.unit_price, action.details.quantity)
  },
  validate({ action, currentOrder }) {
    const refId = action.details?.reference_id
    if (refId == null) {
      throw new MedusaError(
        MedusaError.Types.INVALID_DATA,
        "Details reference ID is required."
      )
    }

    const existing = currentOrder.items.find((item) => item.id === refId)

    if (!existing) {
      throw new MedusaError(
        MedusaError.Types.INVALID_DATA,
        `Item ID "${refId}" not found.`
      )
    }

    if (!action.details?.quantity) {
      throw new MedusaError(
        MedusaError.Types.INVALID_DATA,
        `Quantity to cancel return of item ${refId} is required.`
      )
    }

    const greater = MathBN.gt(
      action.details?.quantity,
      existing.detail?.return_requested_quantity
    )
    if (greater) {
      throw new MedusaError(
        MedusaError.Types.INVALID_DATA,
        `Cannot cancel more items than what was requested to return for item ${refId}.`
      )
    }
  },
})
import {
  ChangeActionType,
  MathBN,
  MedusaError,
} from "@medusajs/framework/utils"
import { OrderChangeProcessing } from "../calculate-order-change"
import { setActionReference } from "../set-action-reference"

OrderChangeProcessing.registerActionType(
  ChangeActionType.RECEIVE_DAMAGED_RETURN_ITEM,
  {
    isDeduction: true,
    operation({ action, currentOrder, previousEvents, options }) {
      const existing = currentOrder.items.find(
        (item) => item.id === action.details.reference_id
      )!

      let toReturn = action.details.quantity

      existing.detail.return_dismissed_quantity ??= 0
      existing.detail.return_requested_quantity ??= 0

      existing.detail.return_dismissed_quantity = MathBN.add(
        existing.detail.return_dismissed_quantity,
        toReturn
      )
      existing.detail.return_requested_quantity = MathBN.sub(
        existing.detail.return_requested_quantity,
        toReturn
      )

      existing.detail.written_off_quantity ??= 0
      existing.detail.written_off_quantity = MathBN.add(
        existing.detail.written_off_quantity,
        action.details.quantity
      )

      setActionReference(existing, action, options)

      return MathBN.mult(existing.unit_price, action.details.quantity)
    },
    validate({ action, currentOrder }) {
      const refId = action.details?.reference_id
      if (refId == null) {
        throw new MedusaError(
          MedusaError.Types.INVALID_DATA,
          "Details reference ID is required."
        )
      }

      const existing = currentOrder.items.find((item) => item.id === refId)

      if (!existing) {
        throw new MedusaError(
          MedusaError.Types.INVALID_DATA,
          `Item ID "${refId}" not found.`
        )
      }

      if (!action.details?.quantity) {
        throw new MedusaError(
          MedusaError.Types.INVALID_DATA,
          `Quantity to return of item ${refId} is required.`
        )
      }

      const quantityRequested = existing?.detail.return_requested_quantity || 0
      if (action.details?.quantity > quantityRequested) {
        throw new MedusaError(
          MedusaError.Types.INVALID_DATA,
          `Cannot receive more items than what was requested to be returned for item ${refId}.`
        )
      }
    },
  }
)
```

```bash
import { BigNumberInput } from "@medusajs/framework/types"
import { MathBN } from "@medusajs/framework/utils"

/**
 * For an action that returns one component of a bundle line item (issue #113),
 * returns the refund amount the return workflows saved on it. Returns
 * `undefined` for any other action.
 *
 * Such an action doesn't change the bundle line's own return quantities: the
 * return workflows track and validate each component's quantities themselves.
 */
export function getBundleComponentAmount(action: {
  details?: { metadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null } | null
}): BigNumberInput | undefined {
  const component = action.details?.metadata?.bundle_component as
    | { amount?: BigNumberInput }
    | undefined

  return component?.amount == null ? undefined : MathBN.convert(component.amount)
}
```

```text
import { setActionReference } from "../set-action-reference"

OrderChangeProcessing.registerActionType(ChangeActionType.RETURN_ITEM, {
  isDeduction: true,
  operation({ action, currentOrder, options }) {
    const existing = currentOrder.items.find(
      (item) => item.id === action.details.reference_id
    )!

    const bundleComponentAmount = getBundleComponentAmount(action)
    if (bundleComponentAmount !== undefined) {
      setActionReference(existing, action, options)
      return bundleComponentAmount
    }

    existing.detail.return_requested_quantity ??= 0
    existing.detail.return_requested_quantity = MathBN.add(
      existing.detail.return_requested_quantity,
      action.details.quantity
    )

    setActionReference(existing, action, options)

      )
    }

    // Bundle component returns are validated per component by the
    // return workflows, not against the bundle line's quantities.
    if (getBundleComponentAmount(action) !== undefined) {
      return
    }

    const quantityAvailable = MathBN.sub(
      existing!.detail?.fulfilled_quantity ?? 0,
      existing!.detail?.return_requested_quantity ?? 0
    )

    const greater = MathBN.gt(action.details?.quantity, quantityAvailable)
    if (greater) {
      throw new MedusaError(
        MedusaError.Types.INVALID_DATA,
        `Cannot request to return more items than what was fulfilled for item ${refId}.`
      )
    }
```

```text
import {
  OrderChangeDTO,
  OrderDTO,
  OrderPreviewDTO,
  OrderWorkflow,
  ReturnDTO,
} from "@medusajs/framework/types"
import { ChangeActionType, OrderChangeStatus } from "@medusajs/framework/utils"
import {
  WorkflowData,
  WorkflowResponse,
  createStep,
  createWorkflow,
  transform,
} from "@medusajs/framework/workflows-sdk"
import { useRemoteQueryStep } from "../../../common"
import { previewOrderChangeStep } from "../../steps"
import {
  throwIfIsCancelled,
  throwIfItemsDoesNotExistsInReturn,
  throwIfOrderChangeIsNotActive,
} from "../../utils/order-validation"
import { createOrderChangeActionsWorkflow } from "../create-order-change-actions"

export type ReceiveItemReturnRequestValidationStepInput = {
  order: Pick<OrderDTO, "id" | "items">
  orderReturn: ReturnDTO
  orderChange: OrderChangeDTO
  items: OrderWorkflow.ReceiveOrderReturnItemsWorkflowInput["items"]
}

export const receiveItemReturnRequestValidationStep = createStep(
  "receive-item-return-request-validation",
  async function (
    {
      order,
      orderChange,
      orderReturn,
      items,
    }: ReceiveItemReturnRequestValidationStepInput,
    context
  ) {
    throwIfIsCancelled(order, "Order")
    throwIfIsCancelled(orderReturn, "Return")
    throwIfOrderChangeIsNotActive({ orderChange })
    throwIfItemsDoesNotExistsInReturn({ orderReturn, inputItems: items })
  }
)

export const receiveItemReturnRequestWorkflowId = "receive-item-return-request"
export const receiveItemReturnRequestWorkflow = createWorkflow(
  receiveItemReturnRequestWorkflowId,
  function (
    input: WorkflowData<OrderWorkflow.ReceiveOrderReturnItemsWorkflowInput>
  ): WorkflowResponse<OrderPreviewDTO> {
    const orderReturn: ReturnDTO = useRemoteQueryStep({
      entry_point: "return",
      fields: ["id", "status", "order_id", "canceled_at", "items.*"],
      variables: { id: input.return_id },
      list: false,
      throw_if_key_not_found: true,
    })

    const order: OrderDTO = useRemoteQueryStep({
      entry_point: "orders",
      fields: ["id", "status", "canceled_at"],
      variables: { id: orderReturn.order_id },
      list: false,
      throw_if_key_not_found: true,
    }).config({ name: "order-query" })

    const orderChange: OrderChangeDTO = useRemoteQueryStep({
      entry_point: "order_change",
      fields: ["id", "status", "order_id", "return_id"],
      variables: {
        filters: {
          order_id: orderReturn.order_id,
          return_id: orderReturn.id,
          status: [OrderChangeStatus.PENDING, OrderChangeStatus.REQUESTED],
        },
      },
      list: false,
    }).config({ name: "order-change-query" })

    receiveItemReturnRequestValidationStep({
      order,
      items: input.items,
      orderReturn,
      orderChange,
    })

    const orderChangeActionInput = transform(
      { order, orderChange, orderReturn, items: input.items },
      ({ order, orderChange, orderReturn, items }) => {
        return items.map((item) => ({
          order_change_id: orderChange.id,
          order_id: order.id,
          return_id: orderReturn.id,
          version: orderChange.version,
          action: ChangeActionType.RECEIVE_RETURN_ITEM,
          internal_note: item.internal_note,
          reference: "return",
          reference_id: orderReturn.id,
          details: {
            reference_id: item.id,
            quantity: item.quantity,
          },
        }))
      }
    )

    createOrderChangeActionsWorkflow.runAsStep({
      input: orderChangeActionInput,
    })

    return new WorkflowResponse(previewOrderChangeStep(order.id))
  }
)
```

```typescript
import type { BigNumberInput } from "@medusajs/framework/types"
import {
  ChangeActionType,
  ContainerRegistrationKeys,
  OrderChangeStatus,
  ReturnStatus,
} from "@medusajs/framework/utils"
import { StepResponse, createStep } from "@medusajs/framework/workflows-sdk"
import {
  BUNDLE_LINE_METADATA_KEY,
  BundleReturnRequestItem,
  ExistingBundleReturn,
  bundleReturnItemKey,
  getReturnedBundleComponent,
  prepareBundleBundleReceiveItemsGuard,
  prepareBundleReceiveItems,
  prepareBundleReturnItems,
} from "../../utils/bundle-refunds"

const getCurrencyPrecision = async (query, currencyCode: string) => {
  const { data } = await query.graph({
    entity: "currency",
    fields: ["code", "decimal_digits"],
    filters: { code: currencyCode },
  })
  return data[0]?.decimal_digits ?? 2
}

/**
 * The items of a return request to prepare.
 */
export type PrepareBundleReturnItemsStepInput = {
  /**
   * The ID of the order the items are returned from.
   */
  order_id: string
  /**
   * The items to return. An item with `component_variant_id` returns that
   * component of a bundle line item.
   */
  items: BundleReturnRequestItem[]
}

export const prepareBundleReturnItemsStepId = "prepare-bundle-return-items"
/**
 * This step prepares the items of a return request for bundles (issue #113).
 *
 * An item that names a bundle component (`component_variant_id`) gets the
 * component and its refund (from the share saved when the order was placed) in
 * its metadata. It validates that the component is part of the bundle and
 * that no more is returned than is left. Whole-bundle returns of a bundle line
 * are limited to bundles none of whose components were returned.
 *
 * Orders without bundles are returned unchanged after one query.
 */
export const prepareBundleReturnItemsStep = createStep(
  prepareBundleReturnItemsStepId,
  async (input: PrepareBundleReturnItemsStepInput, { container }) => {
    const query = container.resolve(ContainerRegistrationKeys.QUERY)

    const {
      data: [order],
    } = await query.graph({
      entity: "order",
      fields: [
        "id",
        "currency_code",
        "items.id",
        "items.title",
        "items.quantity",
        "items.metadata",
        "items.detail.fulfilled_quantity",
        "items.detail.return_requested_quantity",
        "items.detail.return_received_quantity",
        "items.detail.return_dismissed_quantity",
      ],
      filters: { id: input.order_id },
    })

    const requestedIds = new Set(input.items.map((item) => item.id))
    const touchesBundle =
      input.items.some((item) => item.component_variant_id) ||
      (order?.items ?? []).some(
        (item) =>
          requestedIds.has(item.id) && item.metadata?.[BUNDLE_LINE_METADATA_KEY]
      )

    if (!order || !touchesBundle) {
      return new StepResponse(input.items)
    }

    const [{ data: returns }, { data: changes }, precision] = await Promise.all([
      query.graph({
        entity: "return",
        fields: ["id", "status", "items.item_id", "items.quantity", "items.metadata"],
        filters: { order_id: input.order_id },
      }),
      query.graph({
        entity: "order_change",
        fields: ["id", "status", "actions.action", "actions.details"],
        filters: {
          order_id: input.order_id,
          status: [OrderChangeStatus.PENDING, OrderChangeStatus.REQUESTED],
        },
      }),
      getCurrencyPrecision(query, order.currency_code),
    ])

    // Confirmed whole-bundle returns are already in the line's quantities, so
    // only component return items are counted from returns. Pending actions
    // aren't in the quantities yet, so all of them are counted.
    const existingReturns: ExistingBundleReturn[] = [
      ...returns
        .filter((ret) => ret.status !== ReturnStatus.CANCELED)
        .flatMap((ret) => ret.items ?? [])
        .filter((item) => getReturnedBundleComponent(item.metadata))
        .map((item) => ({
          item_id: item.item_id,
          quantity: item.quantity,
          metadata: item.metadata,
        })),
      ...changes
        .flatMap((change) => change.actions ?? [])
        .filter((action) => action.action === ChangeActionType.RETURN_ITEM)
        .map((action) => ({
          item_id: action.details?.reference_id as string,
          quantity: action.details?.quantity as BigNumberInput,
          metadata: action.details?.metadata as Record<string, unknown>,
        })),
    ]

    return new StepResponse(
      prepareBundleReturnItems({
        items: input.items,
        orderItems: order.items.map((item) => ({
          id: item.id,
          title: item.title,
          quantity: item.quantity,
          metadata: item.metadata,
          fulfilled_quantity: item.detail?.fulfilled_quantity,
          return_requested_quantity: item.detail?.return_requested_quantity,
          return_received_quantity: item.detail?.return_received_quantity,
          return_dismissed_quantity: item.detail?.return_dismissed_quantity,
        })),
        existingReturns,
        precision,
      })
    )
  }
)

/**
 * The items of a return to receive (or dismiss as damaged).
 */
export type PrepareBundleReceiveItemsStepInput = {
  /**
   * The ID of the return the items are received for.
   */
  return_id: string
  /**
   * The items to receive. An item with `component_variant_id` receives that
   * component's return item.
   */
  items: BundleReturnRequestItem[]
}

export const prepareBundleReceiveItemsStepId = "prepare-bundle-receive-items"
/**
 * This step prepares the items received for a return with bundle components
 * (issue #113): it names the component and the part of its refund that the
 * received quantity stands for, and validates that no more is received than
 * was returned. Returns without component items are returned unchanged.
 */
export const prepareBundleReceiveItemsStep = createStep(
  prepareBundleReceiveItemsStepId,
  async (input: PrepareBundleReceiveItemsStepInput, { container }) => {
    if (!input.items.some((item) => item.component_variant_id)) {
      return new StepResponse(
        input.items.map(({ component_variant_id, ...item }) => item)
      )
    }

    const query = container.resolve(ContainerRegistrationKeys.QUERY)
    const {
      data: [orderReturn],
    } = await query.graph({
      entity: "return",
      fields: [
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "items.item_id",
        "items.quantity",
        "items.received_quantity",
        "items.metadata",
        "order.currency_code",
      ],
      filters: { id: input.return_id },
    })

    const { data: changes } = await query.graph({
      entity: "order_change",
      fields: ["id", "actions.action", "actions.details"],
      filters: {
        return_id: input.return_id,
        status: [OrderChangeStatus.PENDING, OrderChangeStatus.REQUESTED],
      },
    })

    // Quantities received in the receive change that isn't confirmed yet.
    const pendingReceived: Record<string, number> = {}
    for (const action of changes.flatMap((change) => change.actions ?? [])) {
      if (
        action.action !== ChangeActionType.RECEIVE_RETURN_ITEM &&
        action.action !== ChangeActionType.RECEIVE_DAMAGED_RETURN_ITEM
      ) {
        continue
      }
      const key = bundleReturnItemKey(
        action.details?.reference_id as string,
        action.details?.metadata as Record<string, unknown>
      )
      pendingReceived[key] =
        (pendingReceived[key] ?? 0) + Number(action.details?.quantity ?? 0)
    }

    return new StepResponse(
      prepareBundleReceiveItems({
        items: input.items,
        returnItems: orderReturn?.items ?? [],
        pendingReceived,
        precision: await getCurrencyPrecision(
          query,
          orderReturn?.order?.currency_code
        ),
      })
    )
  }
)
```

```bash
  req: AuthenticatedMedusaRequest<HttpTypes.StoreCreateReturn>,
  res: MedusaResponse<HttpTypes.StoreReturnResponse>
) => {
  const input = req.validatedBody as HttpTypes.StoreCreateReturn

  // Issue #113: only the logged-in customer who owns the order can return a
  // single item of a bundle. Other returns keep working for guests.
  if (input.items.some((item) => item.component_variant_id)) {
    const customerId = req.auth_context?.actor_id
    if (!customerId) {
      throw new MedusaError(
        MedusaError.Types.UNAUTHORIZED,
        "Log in to return a single item from a bundle."
      )
    }

    const query = req.scope.resolve(ContainerRegistrationKeys.QUERY)
    const {
      data: [order],
    } = await query.graph({
      entity: "order",
      fields: ["id", "customer_id"],
      filters: { id: input.order_id },
    })

    if (!order || order.customer_id !== customerId) {
      throw new MedusaError(
        MedusaError.Types.NOT_FOUND,
        `Order with id: ${input.order_id} was not found`
      )
    }
  }

  const workflow = createAndCompleteReturnOrderWorkflow(req.scope)
  const { result } = await workflow.run({
    input,
  })

  res.status(200).json({ return: result as HttpTypes.StoreReturn })
}
EOF
```

```typescript
import type { BigNumberInput } from "@medusajs/framework/types"
import {
  ContainerRegistrationKeys,
  MathBN,
  QueryContext,
} from "@medusajs/framework/utils"
import { StepResponse, createStep } from "@medusajs/framework/workflows-sdk"
import {
  OrderBundleComponent,
  computeBundleRefundShares,
} from "../../order/utils/bundle-refunds"
import { getVariantDisplayName } from "../utils/insufficient-inventory-error"

/**
 * The cart whose bundle lines get refund shares.
 */
export type PrepareBundleRefundSharesStepInput = {
  cart: {
    currency_code: string
    region_id?: string | null
    region?: { id?: string | null } | null
    items?: {
      id: string
      quantity: BigNumberInput
      total?: BigNumberInput | null
      product?: { metadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null } | null
    }[]
  }
}

export const prepareBundleRefundSharesStepId = "prepare-bundle-refund-shares"
/**
 * This step works out, for every bundle line in the cart, each component's
 * share of what was paid for the line (issue #113). The result maps a line
 * item ID to the components to save in the order line item's
 * `metadata.bundle`, which single-item returns later refund from.
 *
 * Normal prices are the components' prices in the cart's currency and region
 * (without sale price lists). Carts without bundles need no queries.
 */
export const prepareBundleRefundSharesStep = createStep(
  prepareBundleRefundSharesStepId,
  async (input: PrepareBundleRefundSharesStepInput, { container }) => {
    const bundleLines = (input.cart.items ?? [])
      .map((item) => ({
        item,
        components: (
          item.product?.metadata?.bundle as
            | { components?: { variant_id: string; quantity: number }[] }
            | undefined
        )?.components,
      }))
      .filter((line) => Array.isArray(line.components))

    const shares: Record<string, { components: OrderBundleComponent[] }> = {}
    if (!bundleLines.length) {
      return new StepResponse(shares)
    }

    const query = container.resolve(ContainerRegistrationKeys.QUERY)
    const regionId = input.cart.region_id ?? input.cart.region?.id

    const [{ data: variants }, { data: currencies }] = await Promise.all([
      query.graph({
        entity: "variant",
        fields: [
          "id",
          "title",
          "product.title",
          "product.variants.id",
          "inventory_items.inventory_item_id",
          "inventory_items.required_quantity",
          "calculated_price.original_amount",
        ],
        filters: {
          id: [
            ...new Set(
              bundleLines.flatMap((line) =>
                line.components!.map((component) => component.variant_id)
              )
            ),
          ],
        },
        context: {
          calculated_price: QueryContext({
            currency_code: input.cart.currency_code,
            ...(regionId ? { region_id: regionId } : {}),
          }),
        },
      }),
      query.graph({
        entity: "currency",
        fields: ["code", "decimal_digits"],
        filters: { code: input.cart.currency_code },
      }),
    ])

    const variantsById = new Map(variants.map((variant) => [variant.id, variant]))
    const precision = currencies[0]?.decimal_digits ?? 2

    for (const { item, components } of bundleLines) {
      shares[item.id] = {
        components: computeBundleRefundShares({
          components: components!.map((component) => {
            const variant = variantsById.get(component.variant_id)
            return {
              variant_id: component.variant_id,
              title: variant
                ? getVariantDisplayName(variant)
                : component.variant_id,
              quantity: component.quantity,
              unit_price: variant?.calculated_price?.original_amount ?? null,
              inventory_items: (variant?.inventory_items ?? []).map(
                (link) => ({
                  inventory_item_id: link.inventory_item_id,
                  required_quantity: link.required_quantity,
                })
              ),
            }
          }),
          lineQuantity: MathBN.convert(item.quantity).toNumber(),
          amountPaid: item.total ?? 0,
          precision,
        }),
      }
    }

    return new StepResponse(shares)
  }
)
```

```typescript
import {
  BUNDLE_COMPONENT_METADATA_KEY,
  OrderBundleComponent,
  allocateComponentRefund,
  bundleReturnItemKey,
  computeBundleRefundShares,
  getComponentRestockAdjustments,
  getOrderBundleComponents,
  getReturnedBundleComponent,
  prepareBundleReceiveItems,
  prepareBundleReturnItems,
} from "../bundle-refunds"

// The issue's scenario: camera 800, lens 300, bag 100, kit sold for 1000.
const cameraKit = (overrides: Partial<{ camera: number | null }> = {}) => [
  {
    variant_id: "camera",
    title: "Camera",
    quantity: 1,
    unit_price: "camera" in overrides ? overrides.camera : 800,
    inventory_items: [{ inventory_item_id: "ii_camera", required_quantity: 1 }],
  },
  {
    variant_id: "lens",
    title: "Lens",
    quantity: 1,
    unit_price: 300,
    inventory_items: [{ inventory_item_id: "ii_lens", required_quantity: 1 }],
  },
  {
    variant_id: "bag",
    title: "Bag",
    quantity: 1,
    unit_price: 100,
    inventory_items: [{ inventory_item_id: "ii_bag", required_quantity: 1 }],
  },
]

const sharesOf = (components: OrderBundleComponent[]) =>
  Object.fromEntries(components.map((c) => [c.variant_id, c.refund_share]))

const sum = (values: number[]) =>
  Math.round(values.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) * 100) / 100

describe("computeBundleRefundShares", () => {
  it("splits the price paid by normal price (AC 7, issue scenario)", () => {
    const result = computeBundleRefundShares({
      components: cameraKit(),
      lineQuantity: 1,
      amountPaid: 1000,
      precision: 2,
    })

    expect(sharesOf(result)).toEqual({
      camera: 666.67,
      lens: 250,
      bag: 83.33,
    })
  })

  it("adds up exactly to the price paid after rounding (AC 9)", () => {
    for (const amountPaid of [1000, 899, 0.01, 0.02, 1234.56, 100]) {
      const result = computeBundleRefundShares({
        components: cameraKit(),
        lineQuantity: 1,
        amountPaid,
        precision: 2,
      })
      expect(sum(result.map((c) => c.refund_share))).toEqual(amountPaid)
    }
  })

  it("gives leftover cents to the largest remainders, the earlier component on a tie (AC 9)", () => {
    // 1.00 split three ways: 0.333... each. One cent left, all remainders
    // equal, so the first component gets it.
    const result = computeBundleRefundShares({
      components: [
        { variant_id: "a", title: "A", quantity: 1, unit_price: 5, inventory_items: [] },
        { variant_id: "b", title: "B", quantity: 1, unit_price: 5, inventory_items: [] },
        { variant_id: "c", title: "C", quantity: 1, unit_price: 5, inventory_items: [] },
      ],
      lineQuantity: 1,
      amountPaid: 1,
      precision: 2,
    })

    expect(sharesOf(result)).toEqual({ a: 0.34, b: 0.33, c: 0.33 })
  })

  it("gives several leftover cents one each, largest remainder first", () => {
    // 0.10 by weights 1:1:1:4 -> 0.0142..., 0.0142..., 0.0142..., 0.0571...
    // floors 0.01,0.01,0.01,0.05 (0.08); two cents left go to the largest
    // remainders: d (0.0071) then a (0.0042, first of the tied ones).
    const result = computeBundleRefundShares({
      components: ["a", "b", "c", "d"].map((id) => ({
        variant_id: id,
        title: id,
        quantity: 1,
        unit_price: id === "d" ? 4 : 1,
        inventory_items: [],
      })),
      lineQuantity: 1,
      amountPaid: 0.1,
      precision: 2,
    })

    expect(sharesOf(result)).toEqual({ a: 0.02, b: 0.01, c: 0.01, d: 0.06 })
  })

  it("weights by component quantity and counts units for every bundle on the line", () => {
    // 2 lenses at 300 + 1 bag at 100: lens weight 600, bag 100.
    const result = computeBundleRefundShares({
      components: [
        { variant_id: "lens", title: "Lens", quantity: 2, unit_price: 300, inventory_items: [] },
        { variant_id: "bag", title: "Bag", quantity: 1, unit_price: 100, inventory_items: [] },
      ],
      lineQuantity: 3,
      amountPaid: 2100,
      precision: 2,
    })

    expect(result).toEqual([
      expect.objectContaining({ variant_id: "lens", quantity: 2, units: 6, refund_share: 1800 }),
      expect.objectContaining({ variant_id: "bag", quantity: 1, units: 3, refund_share: 300 }),
    ])
  })

  it("splits by quantity when a component has no price in the order's currency (AC 12)", () => {
    const result = computeBundleRefundShares({
      components: cameraKit({ camera: null }),
      lineQuantity: 1,
      amountPaid: 900,
      precision: 2,
    })

    expect(sharesOf(result)).toEqual({ camera: 300, lens: 300, bag: 300 })
  })

  it("splits by quantity when every price is 0", () => {
    const result = computeBundleRefundShares({
      components: [
        { variant_id: "a", title: "A", quantity: 1, unit_price: 0, inventory_items: [] },
        { variant_id: "b", title: "B", quantity: 3, unit_price: 0, inventory_items: [] },
      ],
      lineQuantity: 1,
      amountPaid: 100,
      precision: 2,
    })

    expect(sharesOf(result)).toEqual({ a: 25, b: 75 })
  })

  it("uses the currency's precision (no decimals for JPY)", () => {
    const result = computeBundleRefundShares({
      components: cameraKit(),
      lineQuantity: 1,
      amountPaid: 1000,
      precision: 0,
    })

    expect(sharesOf(result)).toEqual({ camera: 667, lens: 250, bag: 83 })
  })

  it("keeps the component's title and inventory links for restocking", () => {
    const [camera] = computeBundleRefundShares({
      components: cameraKit(),
      lineQuantity: 1,
      amountPaid: 1000,
      precision: 2,
    })

    expect(camera).toEqual({
      variant_id: "camera",
      title: "Camera",
      quantity: 1,
      units: 1,
      refund_share: 666.67,
      inventory_items: [{ inventory_item_id: "ii_camera", required_quantity: 1 }],
    })
  })

  it("gives every component 0 when nothing was paid", () => {
    const result = computeBundleRefundShares({
      components: cameraKit(),
      lineQuantity: 1,
      amountPaid: 0,
      precision: 2,
    })

    expect(sharesOf(result)).toEqual({ camera: 0, lens: 0, bag: 0 })
  })
})

describe("allocateComponentRefund", () => {
  it("refunds share x quantity / units when the split is even (AC 14)", () => {
    expect(
      allocateComponentRefund({
        share: 300,
        units: 3,
        previousUnits: 0,
        quantity: 1,
        precision: 2,
      })
    ).toEqual(100)
  })

  it("refunds the whole share for every unit", () => {
    expect(
      allocateComponentRefund({
        share: 83.33,
        units: 1,
        previousUnits: 0,
        quantity: 1,
        precision: 2,
      })
    ).toEqual(83.33)
  })

  it("adds up exactly to the share over several partial returns (AC 16)", () => {
    // 100.00 over 3 units: 33.33 + 33.33 + 33.34
    const refunds = [0, 1, 2].map((previousUnits) =>
      allocateComponentRefund({
        share: 100,
        units: 3,
        previousUnits,
        quantity: 1,
        precision: 2,
      })
    )

    expect(refunds).toEqual([33.33, 33.33, 33.34])
    expect(sum(refunds)).toEqual(100)
  })

  it("returning several units at once refunds the same as one by one", () => {
    expect(
      allocateComponentRefund({
        share: 100,
        units: 3,
        previousUnits: 1,
        quantity: 2,
        precision: 2,
      })
    ).toEqual(66.67)
  })
})

describe("getOrderBundleComponents / getReturnedBundleComponent", () => {
  it("reads saved components, and ignores lines without saved shares", () => {
    const components = [{ variant_id: "a", refund_share: 1 }]
    expect(getOrderBundleComponents({ bundle: { components } })).toBe(components)
    // Ordered before shares were saved (bundle marker without shares).
    expect(
      getOrderBundleComponents({ bundle: { components: [{ variant_id: "a" }] } })
    ).toBeNull()
    expect(getOrderBundleComponents({ bundle: {} })).toBeNull()
    expect(getOrderBundleComponents(null)).toBeNull()
  })

  it("reads the returned component from metadata", () => {
    const component = { variant_id: "bag", title: "Bag", amount: 83.33 }
    expect(getReturnedBundleComponent({ bundle_component: component })).toBe(
      component
    )
    expect(getReturnedBundleComponent({ bundle_component: {} })).toBeNull()
    expect(getReturnedBundleComponent(undefined)).toBeNull()
  })
})

const savedKit = computeBundleRefundShares({
  components: cameraKit(),
  lineQuantity: 1,
  amountPaid: 1000,
  precision: 2,
})

const kitLine = (overrides: Record<string, unknown> = {}) => ({
  id: "item_kit",
  title: "Camera kit",
  quantity: 1,
  fulfilled_quantity: 1,
  return_requested_quantity: 0,
  return_received_quantity: 0,
  return_dismissed_quantity: 0,
  metadata: { bundle: { components: savedKit } },
  ...overrides,
})

const shirtLine = {
  id: "item_shirt",
  title: "Shirt",
  quantity: 1,
  fulfilled_quantity: 1,
  metadata: {},
}

describe("prepareBundleReturnItems", () => {
  it("names the returned component and its refund (AC 13, 14)", () => {
    const [item] = prepareBundleReturnItems({
      items: [{ id: "item_kit", quantity: 1, component_variant_id: "bag" }],
      orderItems: [kitLine()],
      existingReturns: [],
      precision: 2,
    })

    expect(item).toEqual({
      id: "item_kit",
      quantity: 1,
      metadata: {
        [BUNDLE_COMPONENT_METADATA_KEY]: {
          variant_id: "bag",
          title: "Bag",
          amount: 83.33,
        },
      },
    })
  })

  it("keeps the client's metadata and other fields", () => {
    const [item] = prepareBundleReturnItems({
      items: [
        {
          id: "item_kit",
          quantity: 1,
          component_variant_id: "bag",
          metadata: { note: "scratched" },
          reason_id: "rr_1",
        } as any,
      ],
      orderItems: [kitLine()],
      existingReturns: [],
      precision: 2,
    })

    expect(item).toEqual(
      expect.objectContaining({
        reason_id: "rr_1",
        metadata: expect.objectContaining({ note: "scratched" }),
      })
    )
  })

  it("refunds exactly the bundle price once every component is returned (AC 16)", () => {
    const items = prepareBundleReturnItems({
      items: ["camera", "lens", "bag"].map((id) => ({
        id: "item_kit",
        quantity: 1,
        component_variant_id: id,
      })),
      orderItems: [kitLine()],
      existingReturns: [],
      precision: 2,
    })

    expect(
      sum(items.map((item) => item.metadata![BUNDLE_COMPONENT_METADATA_KEY].amount))
    ).toEqual(1000)
  })

  it("leaves items of normal lines unchanged", () => {
    const items = [{ id: "item_shirt", quantity: 1, reason_id: "rr_1" }]
    expect(
      prepareBundleReturnItems({
        items,
        orderItems: [shirtLine, kitLine()],
        existingReturns: [],
        precision: 2,
      })
    ).toEqual(items)
  })

  it("leaves items of unknown lines unchanged for the order checks to reject", () => {
    const items = [{ id: "item_missing", quantity: 1, component_variant_id: "bag" }]
    expect(
      prepareBundleReturnItems({
        items,
        orderItems: [kitLine()],
        existingReturns: [],
        precision: 2,
      })
    ).toEqual([{ id: "item_missing", quantity: 1 }])
  })

  it("allows a whole-bundle return when no component was returned (AC 17)", () => {
    expect(
      prepareBundleReturnItems({
        items: [{ id: "item_kit", quantity: 1 }],
        orderItems: [kitLine()],
        existingReturns: [],
        precision: 2,
      })
    ).toEqual([{ id: "item_kit", quantity: 1 }])
  })

  it("rejects a whole-bundle return after one of its components was returned", () => {
    expect(() =>
      prepareBundleReturnItems({
        items: [{ id: "item_kit", quantity: 1 }],
        orderItems: [kitLine()],
        existingReturns: [
          {
            item_id: "item_kit",
            quantity: 1,
            metadata: { bundle_component: { variant_id: "bag", title: "Bag", amount: 83.33 } },
          },
        ],
        precision: 2,
      })
    ).toThrow(
      'Cannot return 1 of the bundle "Camera kit": only 0 can be returned whole, because items of the other bundles were already returned. Return the remaining items individually instead.'
    )
  })

  it("still allows whole returns of the other bundles on the line", () => {
    expect(
      prepareBundleReturnItems({
        items: [{ id: "item_kit", quantity: 1 }],
        orderItems: [
          kitLine({
            quantity: 2,
            fulfilled_quantity: 2,
            metadata: {
              bundle: {
                components: computeBundleRefundShares({
                  components: cameraKit(),
                  lineQuantity: 2,
                  amountPaid: 2000,
                  precision: 2,
                }),
              },
            },
          }),
        ],
        existingReturns: [
          {
            item_id: "item_kit",
            quantity: 1,
            metadata: { bundle_component: { variant_id: "bag", title: "Bag", amount: 83.33 } },
          },
        ],
        precision: 2,
      })
    ).toEqual([{ id: "item_kit", quantity: 1 }])
  })

  it("rejects a component that isn't in the bundle (AC 19)", () => {
    expect(() =>
      prepareBundleReturnItems({
        items: [{ id: "item_kit", quantity: 1, component_variant_id: "tripod" }],
        orderItems: [kitLine()],
        existingReturns: [],
        precision: 2,
      })
    ).toThrow('Variant tripod is not part of the bundle "Camera kit".')
  })

  it("rejects a component of a line that isn't a bundle", () => {
    expect(() =>
      prepareBundleReturnItems({
        items: [{ id: "item_shirt", quantity: 1, component_variant_id: "bag" }],
        orderItems: [shirtLine],
        existingReturns: [],
        precision: 2,
      })
    ).toThrow("Item item_shirt is not a bundle, so a component can't be returned from it.")
  })

  it("rejects a component of a bundle ordered before shares were saved (AC 19)", () => {
    expect(() =>
      prepareBundleReturnItems({
        items: [{ id: "item_kit", quantity: 1, component_variant_id: "bag" }],
        orderItems: [
          kitLine({ metadata: { bundle: { components: [{ variant_id: "bag" }] } } }),
        ],
        existingReturns: [],
        precision: 2,
      })
    ).toThrow(
      'The bundle "Camera kit" was ordered before single items could be returned. Return the whole bundle instead.'
    )
  })

  it("rejects returning more of a component than was bought (AC 19)", () => {
    expect(() =>
      prepareBundleReturnItems({
        items: [{ id: "item_kit", quantity: 2, component_variant_id: "bag" }],
        orderItems: [kitLine()],
        existingReturns: [],
        precision: 2,
      })
    ).toThrow('Cannot return 2 of "Bag" from the bundle "Camera kit": only 1 can be returned.')
  })

  it("rejects returning a component again after an earlier return (AC 19)", () => {
    expect(() =>
      prepareBundleReturnItems({
        items: [{ id: "item_kit", quantity: 1, component_variant_id: "bag" }],
        orderItems: [kitLine()],
        existingReturns: [
          {
            item_id: "item_kit",
            quantity: 1,
            metadata: { bundle_component: { variant_id: "bag", title: "Bag", amount: 83.33 } },
          },
        ],
        precision: 2,
      })
    ).toThrow('Cannot return 1 of "Bag" from the bundle "Camera kit": only 0 can be returned.')
  })

  it("counts the same component twice in one request", () => {
    expect(() =>
      prepareBundleReturnItems({
        items: [
          { id: "item_kit", quantity: 1, component_variant_id: "bag" },
          { id: "item_kit", quantity: 1, component_variant_id: "bag" },
        ],
        orderItems: [kitLine()],
        existingReturns: [],
        precision: 2,
      })
    ).toThrow('only 0 can be returned')
  })

  it("rejects a component of a bundle that wasn't fulfilled", () => {
    expect(() =>
      prepareBundleReturnItems({
        items: [{ id: "item_kit", quantity: 1, component_variant_id: "bag" }],
        orderItems: [kitLine({ fulfilled_quantity: 0 })],
        existingReturns: [],
        precision: 2,
      })
    ).toThrow('only 0 can be returned')
  })

  it("rejects a component of a bundle that was returned whole", () => {
    for (const field of [
      "return_requested_quantity",
      "return_received_quantity",
      "return_dismissed_quantity",
    ]) {
      expect(() =>
        prepareBundleReturnItems({
          items: [{ id: "item_kit", quantity: 1, component_variant_id: "bag" }],
          orderItems: [kitLine({ [field]: 1 })],
          existingReturns: [],
          precision: 2,
        })
      ).toThrow('only 0 can be returned')
    }
  })

  it("counts pending whole-bundle returns that aren't in the line's quantities yet", () => {
    expect(() =>
      prepareBundleReturnItems({
        items: [{ id: "item_kit", quantity: 1, component_variant_id: "bag" }],
        orderItems: [kitLine()],
        existingReturns: [{ item_id: "item_kit", quantity: 1 }],
        precision: 2,
      })
    ).toThrow('only 0 can be returned')
  })

  it("spreads the refund over earlier returns of the same component", () => {
    const line = kitLine({
      quantity: 3,
      fulfilled_quantity: 3,
      metadata: {
        bundle: {
          components: [
            {
              variant_id: "bag",
              title: "Bag",
              quantity: 1,
              units: 3,
              refund_share: 100,
              inventory_items: [],
            },
          ],
        },
      },
    })
    const existingReturns = [
      {
        item_id: "item_kit",
        quantity: 2,
        metadata: { bundle_component: { variant_id: "bag", title: "Bag", amount: 66.66 } },
      },
    ]

    const [item] = prepareBundleReturnItems({
      items: [{ id: "item_kit", quantity: 1, component_variant_id: "bag" }],
      orderItems: [line],
      existingReturns,
      precision: 2,
    })

    expect(item.metadata![BUNDLE_COMPONENT_METADATA_KEY].amount).toEqual(33.34)
  })
})

describe("prepareBundleReceiveItems", () => {
  const bagReturnItem = (overrides: Record<string, unknown> = {}) => ({
    item_id: "item_kit",
    quantity: 3,
    received_quantity: 0,
    metadata: { bundle_component: { variant_id: "bag", title: "Bag", amount: 100 } },
    ...overrides,
  })

  it("names the received component and its part of the refund", () => {
    const [item] = prepareBundleReceiveItems({
      items: [{ id: "item_kit", quantity: 1, component_variant_id: "bag" }],
      returnItems: [bagReturnItem()],
      precision: 2,
    })

    expect(item).toEqual({
      id: "item_kit",
      quantity: 1,
      metadata: {
        bundle_component: { variant_id: "bag", title: "Bag", amount: 33.33 },
      },
    })
  })

  it("adds up to the return item's refund over partial receipts", () => {
    const amounts = [0, 1, 2].map(
      (received) =>
        prepareBundleReceiveItems({
          items: [{ id: "item_kit", quantity: 1, component_variant_id: "bag" }],
          returnItems: [bagReturnItem({ received_quantity: received })],
          precision: 2,
        })[0].metadata!.bundle_component.amount
    )

    expect(amounts).toEqual([33.33, 33.33, 33.34])
  })

  it("counts quantities received in the pending receive change", () => {
    const [item] = prepareBundleReceiveItems({
      items: [{ id: "item_kit", quantity: 1, component_variant_id: "bag" }],
      returnItems: [bagReturnItem()],
      pendingReceived: { [bundleReturnItemKey("item_kit", bagReturnItem().metadata)]: 2 },
      precision: 2,
    })

    expect(item.metadata!.bundle_component.amount).toEqual(33.34)
  })

  it("rejects receiving more than was returned", () => {
    expect(() =>
      prepareBundleReceiveItems({
        items: [{ id: "item_kit", quantity: 2, component_variant_id: "bag" }],
        returnItems: [bagReturnItem({ received_quantity: 2 })],
        precision: 2,
      })
    ).toThrow('Cannot receive more of "Bag" than was returned.')
  })

  it("rejects a component the return doesn't have", () => {
    expect(() =>
      prepareBundleReceiveItems({
        items: [{ id: "item_kit", quantity: 1, component_variant_id: "lens" }],
        returnItems: [bagReturnItem()],
        precision: 2,
      })
    ).toThrow("The return has no item for variant lens of item item_kit.")
  })

  it("leaves items without a component unchanged", () => {
    expect(
      prepareBundleReceiveItems({
        items: [{ id: "item_shirt", quantity: 1 }],
        returnItems: [bagReturnItem()],
        precision: 2,
      })
    ).toEqual([{ id: "item_shirt", quantity: 1 }])
  })
})

describe("bundleReturnItemKey", () => {
  it("separates return items of different components of one line", () => {
    const bag = { bundle_component: { variant_id: "bag", title: "Bag", amount: 1 } }
    const lens = { bundle_component: { variant_id: "lens", title: "Lens", amount: 1 } }

    expect(bundleReturnItemKey("item_kit", bag)).not.toEqual(
      bundleReturnItemKey("item_kit", lens)
    )
    expect(bundleReturnItemKey("item_kit", null)).toEqual("item_kit")
  })
})

describe("getComponentRestockAdjustments", () => {
  it("restocks only the returned component's inventory items (AC 15)", () => {
    expect(
      getComponentRestockAdjustments({
        received: [{ item_id: "item_kit", quantity: 1, variant_id: "bag" }],
        orderItems: [kitLine()],
      })
    ).toEqual([{ inventory_item_id: "ii_bag", adjustment: expect.anything() }])
  })

  it("multiplies by each link's required quantity and adds up shared items", () => {
    const line = kitLine({
      metadata: {
        bundle: {
          components: [
            {
              variant_id: "kit2",
              title: "Kit",
              quantity: 1,
              units: 1,
              refund_share: 1,
              inventory_items: [
                { inventory_item_id: "ii_a", required_quantity: 2 },
                { inventory_item_id: "ii_b", required_quantity: 1 },
              ],
            },
          ],
        },
      },
    })

    const result = getComponentRestockAdjustments({
      received: [
        { item_id: "item_kit", quantity: 1, variant_id: "kit2" },
        { item_id: "item_kit", quantity: 2, variant_id: "kit2" },
      ],
      orderItems: [line],
    })

    expect(
      result.map((r) => [r.inventory_item_id, Number(r.adjustment.toString())])
    ).toEqual([
      ["ii_a", 6],
      ["ii_b", 3],
    ])
  })

  it("restocks nothing for an unknown line or component", () => {
    expect(
      getComponentRestockAdjustments({
        received: [
          { item_id: "item_other", quantity: 1, variant_id: "bag" },
          { item_id: "item_kit", quantity: 1, variant_id: "tripod" },
        ],
        orderItems: [kitLine()],
      })
    ).toEqual([])
  })
})
```

```typescript
import {
  formatInsufficientInventoryMessage,
  getVariantDisplayName,
  NamedVariant,
  resolveInventoryShortages,
} from "../insufficient-inventory-error"

const kit: NamedVariant = {
  id: "variant_kit",
  title: "Default",
  product: {
    title: "Camera kit",
    variants: [{ id: "variant_kit" }],
    metadata: {
      bundle: {
        components: [
          { variant_id: "variant_camera", quantity: 1 },
          { variant_id: "variant_lens", quantity: 1 },
          { variant_id: "variant_bag", quantity: 1 },
        ],
      },
    },
  },
  inventory_items: [
    { inventory_item_id: "ii_camera" },
    { inventory_item_id: "ii_lens" },
    { inventory_item_id: "ii_bag" },
  ],
}

const component = (id: string, title: string, item: string): NamedVariant => ({
  id,
  title: "Default",
  product: { title, variants: [{ id }], metadata: {} },
  inventory_items: [{ inventory_item_id: item }],
})

const camera = component("variant_camera", "Camera body", "ii_camera")
const lens = component("variant_lens", "Lens", "ii_lens")
const bag = component("variant_bag", "Bag", "ii_bag")

const shirtLarge: NamedVariant = {
  id: "variant_shirt_l",
  title: "L",
  product: {
    title: "T-shirt",
    variants: [{ id: "variant_shirt_s" }, { id: "variant_shirt_l" }],
    metadata: null,
  },
  inventory_items: [{ inventory_item_id: "ii_shirt_l" }],
}

const allVariants = [kit, camera, lens, bag, shirtLarge]

describe("getVariantDisplayName", () => {
  it("uses the product title for a product with one variant", () => {
    expect(getVariantDisplayName(lens)).toEqual("Lens")
  })

  it("adds the variant title when the product has several variants", () => {
    expect(getVariantDisplayName(shirtLarge)).toEqual("T-shirt (L)")
  })

  it("doesn't repeat a variant title that equals the product title", () => {
    expect(
      getVariantDisplayName({
        id: "v",
        title: "Mug",
        product: { title: "Mug", variants: [{ id: "v" }, { id: "w" }] },
      })
    ).toEqual("Mug")
  })

  it("falls back to the variant title, then the ID", () => {
    expect(getVariantDisplayName({ id: "v", title: "Blue" })).toEqual("Blue")
    expect(getVariantDisplayName({ id: "v" })).toEqual("v")
  })
})

describe("resolveInventoryShortages", () => {
  it("names the out-of-stock component and its bundle (AC 1)", () => {
    expect(
      resolveInventoryShortages(
        [{ inventory_item_id: "ii_lens", variant_id: "variant_kit" }],
        allVariants
      )
    ).toEqual([{ bundle: "Camera kit", name: "Lens" }])
  })

  it("names every out-of-stock component (AC 2)", () => {
    expect(
      resolveInventoryShortages(
        [
          { inventory_item_id: "ii_lens", variant_id: "variant_kit" },
          { inventory_item_id: "ii_bag", variant_id: "variant_kit" },
        ],
        allVariants
      )
    ).toEqual([
      { bundle: "Camera kit", name: "Lens" },
      { bundle: "Camera kit", name: "Bag" },
    ])
  })

  it("names the variant of an item that isn't a bundle (AC 3)", () => {
    expect(
      resolveInventoryShortages(
        [{ inventory_item_id: "ii_shirt_l", variant_id: "variant_shirt_l" }],
        allVariants
      )
    ).toEqual([{ name: "T-shirt (L)" }])
  })

  it("lists a shortage once when several lines report it", () => {
    expect(
      resolveInventoryShortages(
        [
          { inventory_item_id: "ii_lens", variant_id: "variant_kit" },
          { inventory_item_id: "ii_lens", variant_id: "variant_kit" },
        ],
        allVariants
      )
    ).toEqual([{ bundle: "Camera kit", name: "Lens" }])
  })

  it("names the bundle when no current component uses the inventory item", () => {
    expect(
      resolveInventoryShortages(
        [{ inventory_item_id: "ii_removed", variant_id: "variant_kit" }],
        allVariants
      )
    ).toEqual([{ name: "Camera kit" }])
  })

  it("skips lines whose variant is unknown", () => {
    expect(
      resolveInventoryShortages(
        [
          { inventory_item_id: "ii_x", variant_id: "variant_unknown" },
          { inventory_item_id: "ii_y" },
        ],
        allVariants
      )
    ).toEqual([])
  })
})

describe("formatInsufficientInventoryMessage", () => {
  it("names the bundle and its out-of-stock component", () => {
    expect(
      formatInsufficientInventoryMessage([{ bundle: "Camera kit", name: "Lens" }])
    ).toEqual("Camera kit: Lens is out of stock.")
  })

  it("lists several components of one bundle together", () => {
    expect(
      formatInsufficientInventoryMessage([
        { bundle: "Camera kit", name: "Lens" },
        { bundle: "Camera kit", name: "Bag" },
      ])
    ).toEqual("Camera kit: Lens, Bag are out of stock.")
  })

  it("names products that aren't bundles one by one", () => {
    expect(
      formatInsufficientInventoryMessage([
        { name: "T-shirt (L)" },
        { name: "Mug" },
        { bundle: "Camera kit", name: "Lens" },
      ])
    ).toEqual(
      "T-shirt (L) is out of stock. Mug is out of stock. Camera kit: Lens is out of stock."
    )
  })

  it("keeps the old generic message when nothing could be named", () => {
    expect(formatInsufficientInventoryMessage([])).toEqual(
      "Some variant does not have the required inventory"
    )
  })
})
```

```text
import { addShippingMethodToCartWorkflow } from "@medusajs/core-flows"
import {
  AdminInventoryItem,
  AdminProduct,
  AdminShippingProfile,
  AdminStockLocation,
  MedusaContainer,
} from "@medusajs/types"
import {
  ContainerRegistrationKeys,
  Modules,
  ProductStatus,
} from "@medusajs/utils"
import {
  adminHeaders,
  generatePublishableKey,
  generateStoreHeaders,
} from "../../../helpers/create-admin-user"

export async function createOrderSeeder({
  api,
  container,
  storeHeaderOverride,
  productOverride,
  additionalProducts,
  stockChannelOverride,
  inventoryItemOverride,
  shippingProfileOverride,
  withoutShipping,
}: {
  api: any
  container: MedusaContainer
  storeHeaderOverride?: any
  productOverride?: AdminProduct
  stockChannelOverride?: AdminStockLocation
  additionalProducts?: { variant_id: string; quantity: number }[]
  inventoryItemOverride?: AdminInventoryItem
  shippingProfileOverride?: AdminShippingProfile | AdminShippingProfile[]
  withoutShipping?: boolean
}) {
  const publishableKey = await generatePublishableKey(container)

  const shippingProfileOverrideArray = !shippingProfileOverride
    ? undefined
    : Array.isArray(shippingProfileOverride)
    ? shippingProfileOverride
    : [shippingProfileOverride]

  const storeHeaders =
    storeHeaderOverride ??
    generateStoreHeaders({
      publishableKey,
    })

  const region = (
    await api.post(
      "/admin/regions",
      { name: "Test region", currency_code: "usd" },
      adminHeaders
    )
  ).data.region

  const salesChannel = (
    await api.post(
      "/admin/sales-channels",
      { name: "first channel", description: "channel" },
      adminHeaders
    )
  ).data.sales_channel

  const stockLocation =
    stockChannelOverride ??
    (
      await api.post(
        `/admin/stock-locations`,
        { name: "test location" },
        adminHeaders
      )
    ).data.stock_location

  const inventoryItem =
    inventoryItemOverride ??
    (
      await api.post(
        `/admin/inventory-items`,
        { sku: "test-variant" },
        adminHeaders
      )
    ).data.inventory_item

  await api.post(
    `/admin/inventory-items/${inventoryItem.id}/location-levels`,
    {
      location_id: stockLocation.id,
      stocked_quantity: 10,
    },
    adminHeaders
  )

  await api.post(
    `/admin/stock-locations/${stockLocation.id}/sales-channels`,
    { add: [salesChannel.id] },
    adminHeaders
  )

  const shippingProfile =
    shippingProfileOverrideArray?.[0] ??
    (
      await api.post(
        `/admin/shipping-profiles`,
        { name: `test-${stockLocation.id}`, type: "default" },
        adminHeaders
      )
    ).data.shipping_profile

  const product =
    productOverride ??
    (
      await api.post(
        "/admin/products",
        {
          title: `Test fixture ${shippingProfile.id}`,
          status: ProductStatus.PUBLISHED,
          shipping_profile_id: withoutShipping ? undefined : shippingProfile.id,
          options: [
            { title: "size", values: ["large", "small"] },
            { title: "color", values: ["green"] },
          ],
          variants: [
            {
              title: "Test variant",
              sku: "test-variant",
              inventory_items: [
                {
                  inventory_item_id: inventoryItem.id,
                  required_quantity: 1,
                },
              ],
              prices: [
                {
                  currency_code: "usd",
                  amount: 100,
                },
              ],
              options: {
                size: "large",
                color: "green",
              },
            },
          ],
        },
        adminHeaders
      )
    ).data.product

  const fulfillmentSets = (
    await api.post(
      `/admin/stock-locations/${stockLocation.id}/fulfillment-sets?fields=*fulfillment_sets`,
      {
        name: `Test-${shippingProfile.id}`,
        type: "test-type",
      },
      adminHeaders
    )
  ).data.stock_location.fulfillment_sets

  const fulfillmentSet = (
    await api.post(
      `/admin/fulfillment-sets/${fulfillmentSets[0].id}/service-zones`,
      {
        name: `Test-${shippingProfile.id}`,
        geo_zones: [{ type: "country", country_code: "us" }],
      },
      adminHeaders
    )
  ).data.fulfillment_set

  await api.post(
    `/admin/stock-locations/${stockLocation.id}/fulfillment-providers`,
    { add: ["manual_test-provider"] },
    adminHeaders
  )

  const remoteLink = container.resolve(ContainerRegistrationKeys.LINK)
  await remoteLink.create([
    {
      [Modules.SALES_CHANNEL]: {
        sales_channel_id: salesChannel.id,
      },
      [Modules.STOCK_LOCATION]: {
        stock_location_id: stockLocation.id,
      },
    },
    {
      [Modules.PRODUCT]: {
        variant_id: product.variants[0].id,
      },
      [Modules.INVENTORY]: {
        inventory_item_id: inventoryItem.id,
      },
    },
  ])

  /**
   * Create shipping options for each shipping profile provided
   */
  const shippingOptions = await Promise.all(
    (shippingProfileOverrideArray || [shippingProfile]).map(async (sp) => {
      return (
        await api.post(
          `/admin/shipping-options`,
          {
            name: `Test shipping option ${fulfillmentSet.id}`,
            service_zone_id: fulfillmentSet.service_zones[0].id,
            shipping_profile_id: sp.id,
            provider_id: "manual_test-provider",
            price_type: "flat",
            type: {
              label: "Test type",
              description: "Test description",
              code: "test-code",
            },
            prices: [
              { currency_code: "usd", amount: 1000 },
              { region_id: region.id, amount: 1100 },
            ],
            rules: [],
          },
          adminHeaders
        )
      ).data.shipping_option
    })
  )

  const shippingOption = shippingOptions[0]

  const cart = (
    await api.post(
      `/store/carts`,
      {
        currency_code: "usd",
        email: "tony@stark-industries.com",
        region_id: region.id,
        shipping_address: {
          address_1: "test address 1",
          address_2: "test address 2",
          city: "ny",
          country_code: "us",
          province: "ny",
          postal_code: "94016",
        },
        billing_address: {
          address_1: "test billing address 1",
          address_2: "test billing address 2",
          city: "ny",
          country_code: "us",
          province: "ny",
          postal_code: "94016",
        },
        sales_channel_id: salesChannel.id,
        items: [
          { quantity: 1, variant_id: product.variants[0].id },
          ...(additionalProducts || []),
        ],
      },
      storeHeaders
    )
  ).data.cart

  if (!withoutShipping) {
    // Create shipping methods for each shipping option so shipping profiles of products in the cart are supported
    await addShippingMethodToCartWorkflow(container).run({
      input: {
        cart_id: cart.id,
        options: shippingOptions.map((so) => ({ id: so.id })),
      },
    })
  }

  const paymentCollection = (
    await api.post(
      `/store/payment-collections`,
      {
        cart_id: cart.id,
      },
      storeHeaders
    )
  ).data.payment_collection

  await api.post(
    `/store/payment-collections/${paymentCollection.id}/payment-sessions`,
    { provider_id: "pp_system_default" },
    storeHeaders
  )

  let order = (
    await api.post(`/store/carts/${cart.id}/complete`, {}, storeHeaders)
  ).data.order

  order = (await api.get(`/admin/orders/${order.id}`, adminHeaders)).data.order

  return {
    order,
    region,
    salesChannel,
    stockLocation,
    inventoryItem,
    shippingProfile,
    product,
    fulfillmentSets,
    fulfillmentSet,
    shippingOption,
    cart,
    paymentCollection,
  }
}
```

```text
  if (errors?.[0]) {
    const error = errors[0].error
    const statusOKErrors: string[] = [
      MedusaError.Types.PAYMENT_AUTHORIZATION_ERROR,
      MedusaError.Types.PAYMENT_REQUIRES_MORE_ERROR,
    ]
    // Inventory errors are NOT_ALLOWED, which other steps also throw, so they are matched by code
    const statusOKErrorCodes: string[] = [
      MedusaError.Codes.INSUFFICIENT_INVENTORY,
    ]

    // If we end up with errors outside of statusOKErrors and statusOKErrorCodes, it means that the cart
    // is not in a state to be completed. In these cases, we return a 400.
    const cartReq = await prepareRetrieveQuery(
      {},
      {
        defaults: defaultStoreCartFields,
      },
      req as MedusaRequest
    )
    const cart = await refetchCart(
      cart_id,
      req.scope,
      cartReq.remoteQueryConfig.fields
    )

    if (
      !statusOKErrors.includes(error?.type) &&
      !statusOKErrorCodes.includes(error?.code)
    ) {
      throw error
    }

    res.status(200).json({
      type: "cart",
      cart,
      error: {
        message: error.message,
        name: error.name,
        type: error.type,
      },
    })
    return
  }
```
